jobs.description:
CSL's R&D organization is accelerating innovation to deliver greater impact for patients. With a project-led structure and a focus on collaboration, we’re building a future-ready team that thrives in dynamic biotech ecosystems. Joining CSL now means being part of an agile team committed to developing therapies that make a meaningful difference worldwide.

You will oversees all areas of single case processing in the global pharmacovigilance database from all sources. This includes ensuring that the vendor performs case processing in accordance with regulatory guidelines, PV agreements, and the Company's SOPs, as well as responding to specific questions or queries about cases. This role develops standards and processes, with a focus on global compliance and process optimization.
Oversees Medical Evaluators responsible for medical review of ICSRs.

Key 
• Responsibilities
Oversight of Case Management Processes activities
Oversight of Medical Evaluator role which completes medical review of the following ICSRs:
All serious cases from all sources
Non-serious cases from company-sponsored clinical study, if required
Legal ICSRs (serious and non-serious)
Reportable cases of combination products with device issue(s) / malfunction (serious and non-serious)
Non-serious ICSRs are processed by Case Managers and reviewed for correct seriousness on an aggregate basis by Medical Evaluator
Medical review includes:
Review of seriousness, listedness and causality assessments
Review of event terms and MedDRA coding
Review of narrative for medical accuracy and consistency
Assessment of the need for Quality Investigations
Generation of medical follow up queries / Targeted Questionnaires
Drive department-wide planning: resource, budget, and org. strategy
Own case management dashboards and governance scorecards
Prepare for internal and external inspections including coordination of creation of presentations
Lead transformation initiatives (e.g., vendor transitions, digital tools)
Monitor regulatory trends and represent PV case management in global initiatives
Coordinate departmental leadership meetings and communication
Pilot innovations (e.g., RPA, AI triage, tech integration)
Align with Clinical, QA, Regulatory, and Safety Science functions
Coordinate creation and update of SOPs
Retain product and process knowledge

Skills and Education Required
Minimum of 10 years of Clinical Trial and Post-marketing Pharmacovigilance (PV) experience with 5 years of managerial/leadership experience
Global pharmacovigilance database knowledge is required along with proficient knowledge of global and local regulatory rules and regulations

Qualifications and Education Required
BS/BA, RN, Pharmacist, or similar

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

Our Benefits
For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL .

You Belong at CSL
At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione L'organizzazione R&D di CSL sta accelerando l'innovazione per fornire un maggiore impatto per i pazienti. Con una struttura guidata dal progetto e un focus sulla collaborazione, stiamo costruendo un team pronto per il futuro che prospera negli ecosistemi biotech dinamici. Unirsi a CSL significa ora essere parte di un team agile impegnato a sviluppare terapie che fanno una differenza significativa in tutto il mondo. Potrai supervisionare tutte le aree di elaborazione di singoli casi nel database globale di farmacovigilanza da tutte le fonti. Ciò include garantire che il fornitore esegue l'elaborazione dei casi in conformità con le linee guida regolamentari, gli accordi fotovoltaici e le SOP della Società, nonché rispondere a specifiche domande o domande sui casi. Questo ruolo sviluppa standard e processi, con un focus sulla conformità globale e l'ottimizzazione dei processi. supervisiona gli valutatori medici responsabili della revisione medica di ICsRs. Responsabilità - Supervisione delle attività dei processi di gestione dei casi - La supervisione del ruolo di valutazione medica che completa la revisione medica dei seguenti ICsR: - Tutti i casi gravi di tutte le fonti - Casi non gravi dello studio clinico sponsorizzato dall'azienda, se necessario - ICsR legali (seri e non gravi) - Segnalabili casi di prodotti combinati con problemi di dispositivo / malfunzionamento (seri e non gravi) - Gli ICsR non gravi vengono elaborati da Case Manager e riesaminati per una corretta serietà su base aggregata da Medical Evaluator - La revisione medica comprende: - Valutazione della gravità, dell'elenco e delle valutazioni della causalità - Recensione dei termini dell'evento e della codifica MedDRA - Rassegna narrativa per accuratezza medica e coerenza - Valutazione della necessità di indagini di qualità - Generazione di domande di follow up medico / Domande mirate - Pianificazione del dipartimento di unità: risorse, budget e org. strategia - dashboard di gestione case proprie e schede di governo - Preparare ispezioni interne ed esterne, compreso il coordinamento della creazione di presentazioni - Iniziative di trasformazione del piombo (ad esempio, transizioni del fornitore, strumenti digitali) - Monitorare le tendenze normative e rappresentare la gestione dei casi fotovoltaici nelle iniziative globali - Coordinare riunioni di leadership dipartimentali e comunicazione - Innovazioni pilota (ad esempio, RPA, AI triage, integrazione tecnologica) - Allineare con funzioni cliniche, QA, Regolazione e Scienze della Sicurezza - Coordinare la creazione e l'aggiornamento delle SOP - Mantenere la conoscenza del prodotto e del processo
• Requisiti - Minimo 10 anni di prova clinica e post-marketing Pharmacovigilance (PV) esperienza con 5 anni di esperienza manageriale/leadership - La conoscenza del database di farmacovigilanza globale è richiesta insieme alla conoscenza competente delle norme e dei regolamenti normativi globali e locali - BS/BA, RN, Pharmacist o simili Informazioni su CSL Behring CSL Behring è un leader globale di biotherapeutics guidato dalla nostra promessa di salvare vite. Concentrati sulle esigenze dei pazienti utilizzando le più recenti tecnologie, scopriamo, sviluppiamo e forniamo terapie innovative per le persone che vivono con condizioni di immunologia, ematologia, cardiovascolare e metabolica, respiratoria e trapianto aree terapeutiche. Utilizziamo tre piattaforme scientifiche strategiche di frazionamento del plasma, tecnologia delle proteine ricombinanti, e terapia cellulare e genica per supportare l'innovazione continua e perfezionare continuamente i modi in cui i prodotti possono affrontare bisogni medici non soddisfatti e aiutare i pazienti a condurre una vita piena. CSL Behring gestisce una delle più grandi reti di raccolta al plasma del mondo, CSL Plasma. La nostra società madre, CSL, con sede a Melbourne, Australia, impiega 32.000 persone, e fornisce le sue terapie salvavita per le persone in più di 100 paesi. Per saperne di più su CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus e CSL Viper visita https://www.csl.com/ e CSL Plasma all'indirizzo https://www.cslplasma.com/ . Benefici - Per ulteriori informazioni sui vantaggi CSL visita Come CSL supporta il tuo benessere | CSL . Inclusione e Appartenenza Tu sei lungo alla CSL A CSL, Inclusione e Belonging è al centro della nostra missione e chi siamo. Esso alimenta la nostra innovazione giorno in e giorno fuori. Festeggiando

descriptionByLocale.de: Beschreibung Die F&D-Organisation von CSL beschleunigt Innovationen, um Patienten stärker zu beeinflussen. Mit einer projektgeführten Struktur und einem Schwerpunkt auf Zusammenarbeit bauen wir ein zukunftsfähiges Team, das in dynamischen Biotech-Ökosystemen lebt. Die Teilnahme an CSL bedeutet nun, Teil eines agilen Teams zu sein, das sich für die Entwicklung von Therapien einsetzt, die weltweit einen sinnvollen Unterschied machen. Sie werden alle Bereiche der Einzelfallverarbeitung in der globalen Pharmakovigilanzdatenbank aus allen Quellen überwachen. Dazu gehört auch, dass der Anbieter die Fallbearbeitung gemäß den gesetzlichen Richtlinien, PV-Vereinbarungen und den SOPs des Unternehmens durchführt, sowie auf spezifische Fragen oder Fragen zu Fällen reagiert. Diese Rolle entwickelt Standards und Prozesse, mit einem Fokus auf globale Compliance und Prozessoptimierung. Beaufsichtigt medizinische Evaluatoren, die für die medizinische Überprüfung von ICsRs verantwortlich sind. In den Warenkorb - Aufsicht über die Aktivitäten von Fallmanagementprozessen - Aufsicht über die Rolle des medizinischen Evaluators, die die medizinische Überprüfung der folgenden ICsRs abschließt: - Alle schweren Fälle aus allen Quellen - Unerwünschte Fälle von unternehmensverantworteten klinischen Studien, falls erforderlich - Legal ICsRs (serious und nicht-serious) - Reportable Fälle von Kombinationsprodukten mit Geräteproblemen / Störung (serious und nicht-serious) - Nicht-serious ICsRs werden von Case Managern verarbeitet und auf aggregierter Basis von Medical Evaluator auf korrekte Ernsthaftigkeit geprüft - Medizinische Bewertung umfasst: - Überprüfung von Ernsthaftigkeit, Aufzählung und Kausalitätsbewertungen - Überprüfung der Terminbedingungen und MedDRA-Codierung - Überprüfung der Erzählung für medizinische Genauigkeit und Konsistenz - Beurteilung der Notwendigkeit von Qualitätsuntersuchungen - Generation der medizinischen Follow-up-Anfragen / Gezielte Fragebogen - abteilungsweite Planung: Ressourcen, Budget und org. Strategie - Eigene Fallverwaltung Dashboards und Governance Scorecards - Vorbereitung auf interne und externe Inspektionen einschließlich Koordinierung der Erstellung von Präsentationen - Lead-Transformationsinitiativen (z.B. Herstellerübergänge, digitale Werkzeuge) - Überwachung regulatorischer Trends und Vertretung von PV-Fallmanagement in globalen Initiativen - Koordinierte abteilungsführende Treffen und Kommunikation - Pilotinnovationen (z.B. RPA, AI Triage, Tech Integration) - mit klinischen, QA-, Regulator- und Sicherheitswissenschaftsfunktionen - Koordinierte Erstellung und Aktualisierung von SOPs - Produkt- und Prozesswissen beibehalten Voraussetzungen - Mindestens 10 Jahre klinische Studien- und Postmarketing-Erfahrung Pharmakovigilanz (PV) mit 5 Jahren Erfahrung in Führungs- und Führungsqualität - Globales Pharmakovigilanz-Datenbankwissen ist erforderlich, zusammen mit fundierten Kenntnissen der globalen und lokalen Regulierungsvorschriften und Vorschriften - BS/BA, RN, Apotheker oder dergleichen Informazioni su CSL Behring CSL Behring ist ein weltweit führender Biotherapeutiker, der von unserem Versprechen zur Rettung von Leben angetrieben wird. Im Fokus auf die Bedürfnisse der Patienten mit den neuesten Technologien, entdecken, entwickeln und liefern wir innovative Therapien für Menschen mit Bedingungen in der Immunologie, Hämatologie, Herz-Kreislauf- und Stoffwechsel-, Atem- und Transplantationstherapie. Wir nutzen drei strategische wissenschaftliche Plattformen der Plasmafraktionierung, der rekombinanten Proteintechnologie und der Zell- und Gentherapie, um fortwährende Innovation zu unterstützen und kontinuierlich zu verfeinern, wie Produkte ungeeignete medizinische Bedürfnisse ansprechen können und Patienten dabei helfen, das volle Leben zu führen. CSL Behring betreibt eines der weltweit größten Plasmasammlungsnetze, CSL Plasma. Unsere Muttergesellschaft, CSL, mit Sitz in Melbourne, Australien, beschäftigt 32.000 Mitarbeiter und liefert ihre lebenserhaltenden Therapien an Menschen in mehr als 100 Ländern. Weitere Informationen zu CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus und CSL Vifor finden Sie unter http://www.csl.com/ und CSL Plasma unter http://www.cslplasma.com/ . Steuerempfänger - Für weitere Informationen zu CSL-Leistungen besuchen Wie CSL unterstützt Ihr Wohlbefinden | CSL . descriptionByLocale.fr:
Descrizione L'organisme de R-D de CSL accélère l'innovation pour accroître l'impact sur les patients. Avec une structure dirigée par le projet et un accent sur la collaboration, nous construisons une équipe prête à l'avenir qui prospère dans les écosystèmes biotechnologiques dynamiques. Rejoindre CSL signifie maintenant faire partie d'une équipe agile engagée à développer des thérapies qui font une différence significative dans le monde entier. Vous superviserez tous les domaines du traitement des cas dans la base de données mondiale de pharmacovigilance de toutes les sources. Cela comprend de s'assurer que le fournisseur effectue le traitement des cas conformément aux lignes directrices réglementaires, aux ententes sur les VP et aux SOP de la Société, ainsi que de répondre à des questions ou à des questions précises au sujet des cas. Ce rôle développe des normes et des processus, en mettant l'accent sur la conformité mondiale et l'optimisation des processus. Supervise les évaluateurs médicaux responsables de l'examen médical des RC. Responsabilité - Surveillance des activités liées aux processus de gestion des cas - Surveillance du rôle de l'évaluateur médical qui effectue l'examen médical des CI suivants : - Tous les cas graves de toutes provenances - Cas non graves de l'étude clinique parrainée par l'entreprise, si nécessaire - RCI juridiques (graves et non graves) - Cas signalés de produits combinés avec problème(s)/défectuosité (graves et non graves) - Les CI non graves sont traitées par les gestionnaires de cas et examinées pour déterminer si la gravité est correcte sur une base globale par l'évaluateur médical - L'examen médical comprend : - Examen de l'évaluation de la gravité, de la liste et de la causalité - Examen des termes de l'événement et codage MedDRA - Examen de l'exactitude et de l'uniformité médicales - Évaluation de la nécessité d'enquêtes qualité - Génération de demandes de suivi médical / Questionnaires ciblés - Favoriser la planification à l'échelle du ministère : ressources, budget et org. stratégie - Tableau de bord de gestion de cas et fiches de notation de gouvernance - Se préparer aux inspections internes et externes, y compris la coordination de la création des présentations - Principales initiatives de transformation (p. ex. transition des fournisseurs, outils numériques) - Surveiller les tendances réglementaires et représenter la gestion des cas de VP dans les initiatives mondiales - Coordonner les réunions ministérielles de leadership et la communication - Innovations pilotes (par exemple, RPA, triage AI, intégration technologique) - Alignez-vous sur les fonctions cliniques, d'AQ, de réglementation et de sciences de la sécurité - Coordonner la création et la mise à jour des SOP - Conserver les connaissances sur les produits et les procédés
• Requisiti - minimum de 10 ans d'expérience en pharmacovigilance (PV) après l'essai clinique et après la commercialisation avec 5 ans d'expérience en gestion et en leadership - Une connaissance de la base de données mondiale de pharmacovigilance est nécessaire, ainsi qu'une connaissance approfondie des règles et réglementations mondiales et locales - BS/BA, RN, pharmacien, ou similaire Information sur le CSL Behring CSL Behring est un chef de file mondial en biothérapeutique animé par notre promesse de sauver des vies. Concentré sur les besoins des patients en utilisant les dernières technologies, nous découvrons, développons et livrons des thérapies innovantes pour les personnes vivant dans des conditions dans les domaines immunologiques, hématologiques, cardiovasculaires et métaboliques, respiratoires et transplantés. Nous utilisons trois plateformes scientifiques stratégiques de fractionnement plasmatique, la technologie des protéines recombinantes et la thérapie cellulaire et génique pour soutenir l'innovation continue et affiner continuellement les façons dont les produits peuvent répondre aux besoins médicaux non satisfaits et aider les patients à mener une vie entière. CSL Behring exploite l'un des plus grands réseaux mondiaux de collecte de plasma, CSL Plasma. Notre société mère, CSL, basée à Melbourne, en Australie, emploie 32 000 personnes et livre ses thérapies vitales à des personnes dans plus de 100 pays. Pour en savoir plus sur CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus et CSL Vifor, visitez https://www.csl.com/ et CSL Plasma à https://www.cslplasma.com/ . Benefici - Pour plus d'information sur les prestations de LSC, visitez Comment LSC soutient votre bien-être. Inclusione e Appartenenza Vous appartenez à CSL Chez CSL, l'inclusion et l'appartenance sont au cœur de notre mission et de ce que nous sommes. Elle alimente notre journée de l'innovation au quotidien. En célébrant

jobs.title: Associate Director, Pharmacokinetics (PK)
jobs.description:
CSL's R&D organization is accelerating innovation to deliver greater impact for patients. With a project-led structure and a focus on collaboration, we’re building a future-ready team that thrives in dynamic biotech ecosystems. Joining CSL now means being part of an agile team committed to developing therapies that make a meaningful difference worldwide.

Position Description Summary:
The Associate Director PK is responsible for leading the design, execution, and interpretation of pharmacokinetic (PK), toxicokinetic (TK), strategies to support drug discovery, nonclinical and development programs across multiple therapeutic areas. The Sr. Expert will lead a team of Principle and Senior PK Scientists to ensure effective and consistent approaches for IND-enabling PK strategies and studies.

Main Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership

• Lead the design and execution of pharmacokinetic (PK) and toxicokinetic (TK) strategies.

• Provide scientific leadership across drug discovery, nonclinical, and development programs.

• Ensure alignment of PK/TK strategies with overall program goals across multiple therapeutic areas.

Team Management

• Supervise and mentor a team of Principal and Senior PK Scientists.

• Foster a collaborative and high-performance team environment.

• Guide team members in developing and implementing IND-enabling PK strategies.

Study Oversight and Execution

• Oversee the planning, execution, and interpretation of PK/TK studies.

• Ensure scientific rigor and regulatory compliance in studies conducted at external CROs

• Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to study design, data interpretation, and timelines.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Collaborate with Research, NCD and relevant development functions and CMC

• Contribute to regulatory submissions (e.g., INDs, NDAs) by providing PK/TK data and interpretation.

• Represent PK/QSP function in project teams and governance meetings.

Qualifications and Experience Requirements:

• Ph.D. in a Life Sciences discipline such as Pharmacokinetics, Systems Pharmacology, Pharmacometrics, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field.

• 8+ years of industry experience in PK/PD, PBPK.

• Proficiency in relevant software for PK/PD, PBPK.

• Strong understanding of ADME, pharmacology, and translational science.

• Excellent leadership, and project management skills.

• Experience with omics data integration, machine learning, or AI-enhanced modeling is a plus.

• Ability to manage multiple projects and timelines.

• Experience across multiple therapeutic areas and modalities is highly desirable.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to influence at all levels of the organization.

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

Our Benefits
For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL .

You Belong at CSL
At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out.

jobs.description:
Position Description Summary:
The Scientist PK is responsible for monitoring of non-clinical PK/TK studies conducted internally and externally both in a GLP and non-GLP environment and support modelling activities

Main 
• Responsibilities:
Design, oversee, and interpret nonclinical PK/QSP studies (GLP and non-GLP) to support regulatory submissions and drug development.
Conduct PK, PBPK, QSP modelling and/or work with external collaborators.
Prepare and review regulatory nonclinical submission documents.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders including pharmacology, toxicology, clinical, regulatory, and CMC teams.

Qualifications and Experience 
• Requirements:
Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Ph.D. in Life Sciences or related subject area with 3+ years of pharmaceutical development experience in pharma, biotech, or CRO, with a focus on modeling and simulation.
Training in PK/PD, modelling and simulation, using industry standard software packages, such as Phoenix WinNonLin, NONMEM, R, etc.
Excellent communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Experience with CSL’s disease therapeutic areas.
Experience across multiple therapeutic areas and modalities is highly desirable.
May manage projects/processes, working independently with limited supervision
Coaches and reviews the work of lower-level professionals.
Problems faced are difficult and sometimes complex, often requiring understanding of broader set of issues.
Contributes to the planning, performance, evaluation and reporting of scientific experiments at the highest levels of scientific integrity.
Works together with and provide expertise to other team members to achieve specified research project objectives within defined time parameters.

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

Our Benefits
For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL .

You Belong at CSL
At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakeholders, and sustain a diverse workforce that will move our company and industry into the future.
To learn more about inclusion and belonging visit https://www.csl.com/careers/inclusion-and-belonging

Equal Opportunity Employer
CSL is an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you are an individual with a disability and need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please visit https://www.csl.com/accessibility-statement .

jobs.title: Senior Scientist, Pharmacokinetics (PK)
jobs.description:
Position Description Summary:
The Scientist PK is responsible for monitoring of non-clinical PK/TK studies conducted internally and externally both in a GLP and non-GLP environment and support modelling activities.

Main 
• Responsibilities:
Design, oversee, and interpret nonclinical PK/QSP studies (GLP and non-GLP) to support regulatory submissions and drug development.
Conduct PK, PBPK, QSP modelling and/or work with external collaborators.
Prepare and review regulatory nonclinical submission documents.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders including pharmacology, toxicology, clinical, regulatory, and CMC teams.

Qualifications and Experience 
• Requirements:
Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Ph.D. in Life Sciences or related subject area with 3+ years of pharmaceutical development experience in pharma, biotech, or CRO, with a focus on modeling and simulation.
Training in PK/PD, modelling and simulation, using industry standard software packages, such as Phoenix WinNonLin, NONMEM, R, etc.
Excellent communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Experience with CSL’s disease therapeutic areas.
Experience across multiple therapeutic areas and modalities is highly desirable.
May manage projects/processes, working independently with limited supervision
Coaches and reviews the work of lower-level professionals.
Problems faced are difficult and sometimes complex, often requiring understanding of broader set of issues.
Contributes to the planning, performance, evaluation and reporting of scientific experiments at the highest levels of scientific integrity.
Works together with and provide expertise to other team members to achieve specified research project objectives within defined time parameters.

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

Our Benefits
For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL .

You Belong at CSL
At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakeholders, and sustain a diverse workforce that will move our company and industry into the future.
To learn more about inclusion and belonging visit https://www.csl.com/careers/inclusion-and-belonging

Equal Opportunity Employer
CSL is an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you are an individual with a disability and need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please visit https://www.csl.com/accessibility-statement .

jobs.title: Principal Biostatistician
jobs.description:
CSL's R&D organization is accelerating innovation to deliver greater impact for patients. With a project-led structure and a focus on collaboration, we’re building a future-ready team that thrives in dynamic biotech ecosystems. Joining CSL now means being part of an agile team committed to developing therapies that make a meaningful difference worldwide.

As Principal Biostatistician you will provide high level expertise in the specialist area of Research Biostatistics. You will support research activities in alignment with the respective Therapeutic Area (TA) Research Strategies. In collaboration with Research teams contribute statistical input towards experimental designs, statistical analyses, interpretation and reporting of research studies, to ensure efficient use of resources as well as robust conclusions and deliveries following regulatory requirements and guidelines. The position plays a key role in executing research strategies, fostering internal and external partnerships, and ensuring delivery of impactful preclinical and translational science packages that support clinical development and business objectives.

Main Responsibilities:

Functional Responsibilities​

• Execute Biostatistics strategies aligned with global therapeutic area (TA) and platform priorities, closely collaborating with across Global Research with key connections with Bioinformatics & AI, Translational Research, Research Therapeutic area leads and research project teams​

• Maintain relevant state-of-the-art knowledge and capabilities through literature review and participation in scientific meetings​

• Oversee statistical design and analysis routines in experiments that translate development strategies into plans to support product development objectives, including process control and validation strategies.​

• Utilise expertise to provide statistical input towards experimental designs, statistical analyses, interpretation and reporting of research studies ​

• Provide statistical advice for contacts with regulatory agencies for pre-clinical R&D topics, e.g., in animal ethics applications​

• Contribute statistical input for regulatory filings for product approvals, for on-market support, and for scientific publications ​

• Coordinate with other data analysis/computational experts (Data Managers, Bioinformaticians, Imaging & AI Analysts, PK/PD/Pharmacometricians, etc.) both in house and externally, to ensure that CSL R&D is current and compliant in statistical methods​

Scientific Innovation & Communication​

• Provide scientific input across R&D programs, including drug discovery, in vitro pharmacology, biomarker development, and OMICS studies..​

• Execute Biostatistical pipelines to enable early decision making across research, drive efficiency and generation of high quality data ​

• Compile scientific reports, regulatory documents, and peer-reviewed publications.​

• Present research findings at internal and external meetings and maintain state-of-the-art knowledge through literature and congress participation.​

External Collaboration & Representation​

• Establish and maintain collaborations with academic institutions, biotech companies, CROs, and other external partners to support execution of the Research Project Portfolio.

• Support patent filings and legal contract negotiations in collaboration with CSL’s legal and IP departments.​

Qualifications and Experience Requirements:

• Postgraduate degree (preferably PhD) in Statistics, Biostatistics, or equivalent experience​

• Minimum of 5 years of experience in pharmaceutical or biotech R&D, or equivalent experience in a relevant academic environment.​

• Proven\ experience in working with scientific teams in a global, cross-functional environment.​

• Excellent communication, analytical, and interpersonal skills..​

descriptionByLocale.en:
CSL's R&D organization is accelerating innovation to deliver greater impact for patients. With a project-led structure and a focus on collaboration, we’re building a future-ready team that thrives in dynamic biotech ecosystems. Joining CSL now means being part of an agile team committed to developing therapies that make a meaningful difference worldwide. As Principal Biostatistician you will provide high level expertise in the specialist area of Research Biostatistics. You will support research activities in alignment with the respective Therapeutic Area (TA) Research Strategies. In collaboration with Research teams contribute statistical input towards experimental designs, statistical analyses, interpretation and reporting of research studies, to ensure efficient use of resources as well as robust conclusions and deliveries following regulatory requirements and guidelines. The position plays a key role in executing research strategies, fostering internal and external partnerships, and ensuring delivery of impactful preclinical and translational science packages that support clinical development and business objectives. Main Responsibilities: Functional Responsibilities​
• Execute Biostatistics strategies aligned with global therapeutic area (TA) and platform priorities, closely collaborating with across Global Research with key connections with Bioinformatics & AI, Translational Research, Research Therapeutic area leads and research project teams​
• Maintain relevant state-of-the-art knowledge and capabilities through literature review and participation in scientific meetings​
• Oversee statistical design and analysis routines in experiments that translate development strategies into plans to support product development objectives, including process control and validation strategies.​
• Utilise expertise to provide statistical input towards experimental designs, statistical analyses, interpretation and reporting of research studies ​
• Provide statistical advice for contacts with regulatory agencies for pre-clinical R&D topics, e.g., in animal ethics applications​
• Contribute statistical input for regulatory filings for product approvals, for on-market support, and for scientific publications ​
• Coordinate with other data analysis/computational experts (Data Managers, Bioinformaticians, Imaging & AI Analysts, PK/PD/Pharmacometricians, etc.) both in house and externally, to ensure that CSL R&D is current and compliant in statistical methods​ Scientific Innovation & Communication​
• Provide scientific input across R&D programs, including drug discovery, in vitro pharmacology, biomarker development, and OMICS studies..​
• Execute Biostatistical pipelines to enable early decision making across research, drive efficiency and generation of high quality data ​
• Compile scientific reports, regulatory documents, and peer-reviewed publications.​
• Present research findings at internal and external meetings and maintain state-of-the-art knowledge through literature and congress participation.​ External Collaboration & Representation​
• Establish and maintain collaborations with academic institutions, biotech companies, CROs, and other external partners to support execution of the Research Project Portfolio.
• Support patent filings and legal contract negotiations in collaboration with CSL’s legal and IP departments.​ Qualifications and Experience Requirements:
• Postgraduate degree (preferably PhD) in Statistics, Biostatistics, or equivalent experience​
• Minimum of 5 years of experience in pharmaceutical or biotech R&D, or equivalent experience in a relevant academic environment.​
• Proven\ experience in working with scientific teams in a global, cross-functional environment.​
• Excellent communication, analytical, and interpersonal skills..​
• Demonstrated ability to drive innovation, manage complex projects, and translate scientific insights into strategic value.​

L'organisme de R-D de CSL accélère l'innovation pour accroître l'impact sur les patients. Avec une structure dirigée par le projet et un accent sur la collaboration, nous construisons une équipe prête à l'avenir qui prospère dans les écosystèmes biotechnologiques dynamiques. Rejoindre CSL signifie maintenant faire partie d'une équipe agile engagée à développer des thérapies qui font une différence significative dans le monde entier. En tant que biostatisticien principal, vous fournirez une expertise de haut niveau dans le domaine spécialisé de la biostatistique de recherche. Vous soutiendrez les activités de recherche conformément aux stratégies de recherche respectives du domaine thérapeutique. En collaboration avec les équipes de recherche, contribuer à la conception expérimentale, à l'analyse statistique, à l'interprétation et à l'établissement de rapports sur les études de recherche, afin d'assurer une utilisation efficace des ressources ainsi que des conclusions et des livraisons solides conformément aux exigences réglementaires et aux lignes directrices. Le poste joue un rôle clé dans l'exécution de stratégies de recherche, la promotion de partenariats internes et externes et la prestation de trousses scientifiques précliniques et translationnelles qui appuient le développement clinique et les objectifs opérationnels. Principales responsabilités : Responsabilités fonctionnelles
• Exécuter des stratégies de biostatistique alignées sur les priorités du domaine thérapeutique mondial (TA) et de la plate-forme, en collaborant étroitement avec l'ensemble de la recherche mondiale avec des liens clés avec la bioinformatique et l'IA, la recherche translationnelle, la recherche Les chefs de file du domaine thérapeutique et les équipes de projet de recherche
• Maintenir les connaissances et les capacités pertinentes à la fine pointe de la technologie grâce à l'examen de la documentation et à la participation à des réunions scientifiques
• Superviser les routines de conception et d'analyse statistiques dans les expériences qui traduisent les stratégies de développement en plans d'appui aux objectifs de développement des produits, y compris les stratégies de contrôle des processus et de validation.
• Utiliser l'expertise pour apporter une contribution statistique à la conception expérimentale, aux analyses statistiques, à l'interprétation et à la communication d'études de recherche
• Fournir des conseils statistiques pour les contacts avec les organismes de réglementation dans les domaines de la R-D préclinique, par exemple dans les applications en éthique animale
• Apporter des données statistiques pour les dépôts réglementaires pour l'approbation des produits, pour le soutien sur le marché et pour les publications scientifiques
• Coordonner avec d'autres experts en analyse de données/computation (gestionnaires de données, bioinformaticiens, analystes de l'imagerie et de l'intelligence artificielle, PK/PD/Pharmacometiciens, etc.) tant à l'interne qu'à l'externe, pour s'assurer que la R & D CSL est à jour et conforme aux méthodes statistiques Innovation scientifique et communication
• Fournir des données scientifiques dans le cadre des programmes de R-D, y compris la découverte de médicaments, la pharmacologie in vitro, le développement de biomarqueurs et les études OMICS.
• Exécuter des pipelines biostatistiques pour permettre une prise de décision rapide dans la recherche, stimuler l'efficacité et la production de données de haute qualité
• Compiler des rapports scientifiques, des documents réglementaires et des publications évaluées par les pairs.
• Présenter les résultats de la recherche lors de réunions internes et externes et maintenir des connaissances de pointe grâce à la littérature et à la participation aux congrès. Collaboration et représentation externes
• Établir et maintenir des collaborations avec des établissements universitaires, des entreprises de biotechnologie, des CRO et d'autres partenaires externes pour soutenir l'exécution du portefeuille de projets de recherche.
• Soutenir les dépôts de brevets et les négociations de contrats juridiques en collaboration avec les services juridiques et de propriété intellectuelle de la CSL. Qualifications et exigences en matière d'expérience :
• Diplôme de troisième cycle (de préférence doctorat) en statistique, biostatistique ou expérience équivalente
• Au moins 5 années d'expérience en R-D pharmaceutique ou biotechnologique, ou une expérience équivalente dans un environnement académique pertinent.
• Expérience éprouvée de travail avec des équipes scientifiques dans un environnement global et interfonctionnel.
• Excellentes compétences en communication, en analyse et en relations interpersonnelles.
• Capacité démontrée de stimuler l'innovation, de gérer des projets complexes et de traduire les connaissances scientifiques en valeur stratégique.
• Haute intégrité, compétences organisationnelles

jobs.description:
The Opportunity:

• Designs and implements AI, Automation and data analytics solutions to drive data strategies for the organization or functions within the organization.

• Supports traditional reporting and dashboards and may apply advanced analytics and data science.

• Develops, inspects, mines, transforms, and models data to raise productivity, improve decision making, and gain competitive advantage.

• Uses advanced analytics and data science as primary tools to understand and analyze business processes and other relevant factors, and may support traditional reporting and dashboards.

The Role:

• Responsible for development, implementation and maintenance of AI strategy for Supply chain solutions, data sets, reporting and analytics to enable data-driven decisions

• Collaborates with process teams to elicit and understand requirements, challenges and potential solutions

• Defines data governance structure, in collaboration with global data owners, and ensures compliance with standards and controls

• Defines standards, develops/conducts training and provides advanced support to the business

• Works with global process owner(s) and senior functional leaders on the effective utilization of metrics and analytics within their area

• Researches and applies knowledge of data technology and techniques to provide best practice guidance to the business

• Collaborates with functional business units to drive business solutions and direction

Skills & Experience:

• Bachelor degree in a technical field relevant to business process engineering, computer science or AI; advanced degree preferred

• 8+ years' experience in reporting and analytics

• AI, Automation, Advanced analytics and/or data science experience

• Hands-on experience with traditional modern business intelligence reporting tools, e.g. MS Fabric, AWS platform, DataBricks QlikView, Tableau, etc.

• Demonstrated big data experience with Hadoop-based tools, Hortonworks preferred

• Experience with SAP, HANA preferred

Different qualifications or responsibilities may apply based on local legal and/or educational requirements. Refer to local job documentation where applicable.

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

Our Benefits
For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL .

You Belong at CSL
At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakeholders, and sustain a diverse workforce that will move our company and industry into the future.
To learn more about inclusion and belonging visit https://www.csl.com/careers/inclusion-and-belonging

Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.description:
Position Purpose:
The Director, Senior Global Regulatory Lead (Sr. GRL) in Global Regulatory Strategy (GRS) is a member of the respective GRA GRS Therapeutic Area and contributes to the vision and goals of CSL as follows:

• Develops a global, integrated regulatory strategy ensuring innovative and scientifically sound regulatory approaches for assigned products, with a patient-centric focus and appropriate risk-taking to achieve successful regulatory outcomes from early development through post-marketing lifecycle activities.

• Acts as a key member and single GRA representative for Product Strategy Teams (PST) and related global R&D/commercial teams, while leading the Global Regulatory Affairs Strategy Team (GRAST) to ensure alignment and a unified regulatory voice.

• Leads health authority interactions (FDA, EMA) and builds productive relationships to drive positive regulatory outcomes globally.

• Engages GRAST members to deliver regulatory outputs, fosters accountability and collaboration, and serves as decision-maker/approver for regulatory deliverables. Ensures strong communication between regulatory and R&D teams.

• For selected roles, manages Regional Regulatory Leads and supports their development and career growth.

Main Responsibilities and Accountabilities:

• Builds strong relationships with Product Strategy Teams, Clinical Development Teams, Safety Management Teams, and other stakeholders to ensure effective collaboration and communication.

• Manages strategic relationships with key health authorities (FDA, EMA) and coordinates with regional leads for non-home country interactions.

• Acts as the single GRA reviewer/approver for key deliverables and participates in regulatory due diligence and senior-level discussions.

• Leads preparation of key regulatory documents and mentors GRAST members.

• Utilizes regulatory intelligence, analytics, and cross-functional expertise to develop global regulatory strategies.

• Promotes consistency, collaboration, and knowledge sharing across Global Regulatory Strategy teams.

• Coaches team members (where applicable) to develop innovative solutions and ensure timely execution of regulatory strategies.

• Applies CSL leadership capabilities and supports talent development, succession planning, and team empowerment.

Position Qualifications and Experience Requirements:

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in pharmacy, biology, chemistry, pharmacology, clinical medicine, or related life science required. Advanced degree (MS, PhD, MD, DVM) or MBA preferred.

• Minimum 10 years in biotech or pharmaceutical industry, including at least 8 years in regulatory affairs and 5 years with developmental products.

• Experience leading teams (preferably 5 years), including decision-making and fostering collaboration.

• Knowledge of product development and regulatory requirements across major regions (EU, US, Japan).

• Experience interacting directly with at least one health authority.

• Experience working in a complex, matrix environment preferred.

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor vis

• Costruire relazioni forti con i team di strategia del prodotto, i team di sviluppo clinico, i team di gestione della sicurezza e altri stakeholder per garantire una collaborazione e una comunicazione efficaci.
• Gestisce le relazioni strategiche con le autorità sanitarie chiave (FDA, EMA) e le coordinate con i lead regionali per le interazioni dei paesi non domestici.
• Atto come unico esaminatore GRA/approvazione per i consegnabili chiave e partecipa a due diligence regolamentare e discussioni di alto livello.

• Utilizza l'intelligenza, l'analisi e la competenza multifunzionale per sviluppare strategie di regolamentazione globali.
• Promuove la coerenza, la collaborazione e la condivisione delle conoscenze nei team di Global Regulatory Strategy.
• I membri del team Coaches (dove applicabile) per sviluppare soluzioni innovative e garantire l'esecuzione tempestiva delle strategie di regolazione.
• Riguarda le capacità di leadership CSL e supporta lo sviluppo del talento, la pianificazione della successione e l'empowerment del team. Qualifiche di posizione e requisiti di esperienza:
• Istruzione: laurea in farmacia, biologia, chimica, farmacologia, medicina clinica o scienze della vita correlate richiesto. Grado avanzato (MS, PhD, MD, DVM) o MBA preferito.
• Minimo 10 anni nell'industria biotecnologica o farmaceutica, compresi almeno 8 anni negli affari normativi e 5 anni con prodotti di sviluppo.
• Esperienza di team leader (preferibilmente 5 anni), tra cui il processo decisionale e la collaborazione di promozione.
• Conoscenza dello sviluppo dei prodotti e dei requisiti normativi nelle principali regioni (UE, Stati Uniti, Giappone).
• Esperienza che interagisce direttamente con almeno un'autorità sanitaria.
• Esperienza di lavoro in un ambiente complesso e matrice preferito. Informazioni su CSL Behring CSL Behring è un leader globale di biotherapeutics guidato dalla nostra promessa di salvare vite. Concentrati sulle esigenze dei pazienti utilizzando le più recenti tecnologie, scopriamo, sviluppiamo e forniamo terapie innovative per le persone che vivono con condizioni di immunologia, ematologia, cardiovascolare e metabolica, respiratoria e trapianto aree terapeutiche. Utilizziamo tre piattaforme scientifiche strategiche di frazionamento del plasma, tecnologia delle proteine ricombinanti, e terapia cellulare e genica per supportare l'innovazione continua e perfezionare continuamente i modi in cui i prodotti possono affrontare bisogni medici non soddisfatti e aiutare i pazienti a condurre una vita piena. CSL Behring gestisce una delle più grandi reti di raccolta al plasma del mondo, CSL Plasma. La nostra società madre, CSL, con sede a Melbourne, Australia, impiega 32.000 persone, e fornisce le sue terapie salvavita per le persone in più di 100 paesi. • Il agit en tant qu'examinateur/représentateur unique du GRA pour les principaux produits livrables et participe à la diligence réglementaire et aux discussions de haut niveau.

• Utilise le renseignement réglementaire, l'analyse et l'expertise interfonctionnelle pour élaborer des stratégies réglementaires mondiales.
• Promouvoir la cohérence, la collaboration et le partage des connaissances entre les équipes de la Stratégie mondiale de réglementation.
• Encadre les membres de l'équipe (le cas échéant) pour développer des solutions innovantes et assurer l'exécution en temps opportun des stratégies réglementaires.
• Applique les capacités de leadership du CSL et appuie le développement des talents, la planification de la relève et l'autonomisation des équipes. Qualifications du poste et exigences relatives à l'expérience :
• Formation: Baccalauréat en pharmacie, biologie, chimie, pharmacologie, médecine clinique ou sciences de la vie connexes requis. Diplôme avancé (MS, PhD, MD, DVM) ou MBA préféré.
• Au moins 10 ans dans l'industrie biotechnologique ou pharmaceutique, y compris au moins 8 ans dans les affaires réglementaires et 5 ans avec des produits de développement.
• Expérience des équipes dirigeantes (de préférence 5 ans), y compris la prise de décisions et la promotion de la collaboration.
• Connaissance du développement des produits et des exigences réglementaires dans les grandes régions (UE, États-Unis, Japon).
• Expérience d'interaction directe avec au moins une autorité sanitaire.
• Expérience dans un environnement complexe et matriciel préféré. À propos de CSL Behring CSL Behring est un chef de file mondial en biothérapeutique animé par notre promesse de sauver des vies. Concentré sur les besoins des patients en utilisant les dernières technologies, nous découvrons, développons et livrons des thérapies innovantes pour les personnes vivant dans des conditions dans les domaines immunologiques, hématologiques, cardiovasculaires et métaboliques, respiratoires et transplantés. Nous utilisons trois plateformes scientifiques stratégiques de fractionnement plasmatique, la technologie des protéines recombinantes et la thérapie cellulaire et génique pour soutenir l'innovation continue et affiner continuellement les façons dont les produits peuvent répondre aux besoins médicaux non satisfaits et aider les patients à mener une vie entière. CSL Behring exploite l'un des plus grands réseaux mondiaux de collecte de plasma, CSL Plasma. Notre société mère, CSL, basée à Melbourne, en Australie, emploie 32 000 personnes et livre ses thérapies vitales à des personnes dans plus de 100 pays. jobs.title: EMEA Total Rewards Partner
jobs.description:
At CSL, we believe that our people are our most valuable asset in our quest to save lives and protect the health of people around the world. As a EMEA Total Rewards Partner , your purpose is to ensure that every team member across the region feels valued and recognized for their contribution. By managing competitive and fair frameworks, you aren't just looking at spreadsheets—you are building the foundation that allows our scientists and professionals to focus on what they do best: delivering life-saving therapies to patients.

The Opportunity
This is a highly visible partnering role where you will act as a key advisor within our total rewards landscape. You won't just be administering plans; you will be the strategic bridge between global strategy and regional execution. Partnering closely with HR Business Partners and Business Leaders, you will navigate the complexities of diverse labour markets across EMEA. Your expertise will be relied upon to provide data-driven insights for complex hiring and retention decisions, ensuring that CSL remains an employer of choice while keeping our "Promise" to our employees through a comprehensive and attractive offer.

Key Responsibilities

• Strategic Partnering: Acting as the go-to subject matter expert for HRBPs and business leaders, providing consultative, data-driven advice for complex compensation challenges.

• Regional Program Management: Implementing and managing CSL’s reward programs across the EMEA region.

• Market Intelligence: Leading participation in analysing market trends to ensure our reward structures remain competitive and equitable.

• Global Alignment: Working closely with the Global Compensation, Benefits and Equity teams to ensure regional needs are represented in enterprise-wide initiatives, including Workday compensation cycles.

• Compliance & Governance: Overseeing statutory requirements and ensuring all pay practices adhere to local labour laws and internal CSL governance.

Requirements

• Qualifications: A Bachelor’s degree in Business, HR, Finance, or a related field is required. Professional certifications (e.g., CCP or equivalent) are highly regarded.

• Experience: Significant experience in Compensation and Benefits, specifically within a large, complex multinational organization across the EMEA region.

• Systems Expertise: Strong proficiency in HRIS platforms (Workday preferred) and advanced Excel skills for complex data modelling and analysis.

• Communication: Proven ability to translate complex financial data into clear, actionable advice for stakeholders at all levels.

• Influencing: Ability to influence views and behaviours to ensure the appropriate reward decisions are being made within CSL

Languages: Fluency in English is essential; however, a strong professional proficiency in at least one additional European language is highly preferred to effectively partner across our diverse regional footprint.

About CSL Seqirus
CSL Seqirus is part of CSL. As one of the largest influenza vaccine providers in the world, CSL Seqirus is a major contributor to the prevention of influenza globally and a transcontinental partner in pandemic preparedness. With state-of-the-art production facilities in the U.S., the U.K. and Australia, CSL Seqirus utilizes egg, cell and adjuvant technologies to offer a broad portfolio of differentiated influenza vaccines in more than 20 countries around the world.

In CSL, crediamo che la nostra gente sia la nostra risorsa più preziosa nella nostra ricerca per salvare vite e proteggere la salute delle persone in tutto il mondo. Come partner EMEA Total Rewards, il vostro scopo è quello di garantire che ogni membro del team di tutta la regione si senta apprezzato e riconosciuto per il loro contributo. Gestire i quadri competitivi e giusti, non si sta solo guardando i fogli di calcolo – si sta costruendo la fondazione che permette ai nostri scienziati e professionisti di concentrarsi su ciò che fanno meglio: fornire terapie salvavita ai pazienti. L'opportunità Questo è un ruolo di partner altamente visibile in cui si agirà come consulente chiave nel nostro paesaggio di ricompense totali. Non sarà solo amministrare i piani; sarete il ponte strategico tra la strategia globale e l'esecuzione regionale. Collaborando a stretto contatto con HR Business Partners e Business Leaders, navigherete le complessità dei diversi mercati del lavoro in EMEA. La vostra esperienza sarà affidata a fornire informazioni basate sui dati per decisioni complesse di assunzione e conservazione, assicurando che CSL rimanga un datore di lavoro di scelta, mantenendo il nostro "Promesso" ai nostri dipendenti attraverso un'offerta completa e attraente. Principali responsabilità
• Partner Strategico: Agire come esperto di materia per le risorse umane e i leader aziendali, fornendo consigli consultivi e basati sui dati per complesse sfide di compensazione.
• Gestione del Programma Regionale: attuazione e gestione dei programmi di premiazione della CSL nella regione EMEA.
• Intelligenza di mercato: la partecipazione principale alle tendenze di mercato analizzando per garantire che le nostre strutture di ricompensa rimangano competitive ed equa.
• Allineamento globale: lavorare a stretto contatto con i team Global Compensation, Benefits e Equity per garantire che le esigenze regionali siano rappresentate in iniziative a livello aziendale, compresi i cicli di compensazione Workday.
• Compliance & Governance: supervisionare i requisiti di legge e garantire che tutte le pratiche di pagamento aderiscano alle leggi del lavoro locali e alla governance interna della CSL. Requisiti
• Qualifiche: è richiesto un Bachelor in Business, HR, Finanza o un campo correlato. Le certificazioni professionali (ad esempio, CCP o equivalente) sono altamente considerate.
• Esperienza: Esperienza significativa in Compensazione e Vantaggi, in particolare all'interno di una grande e complessa organizzazione multinazionale nella regione EMEA.
• Competenza dei sistemi: forte competenza nelle piattaforme HRIS (preferito Workday) e competenze avanzate di Excel per la modellazione e l'analisi dei dati complessi.
• Comunicazione: comprovata capacità di tradurre dati finanziari complessi in una consulenza chiara e fattibile per gli stakeholder a tutti i livelli.
• Influenza: Capacità di influenzare le opinioni e i comportamenti per garantire che le decisioni di ricompensa siano prese all'interno della CSL Lingue: La fluenza in inglese è essenziale; tuttavia, una forte competenza professionale in almeno una lingua europea aggiuntiva è altamente preferito per collaborare efficacemente attraverso la nostra diversa impronta regionale. Informazioni su CSL Seqirus CSL Seqirus fa parte della CSL. Come uno dei più grandi fornitori di vaccini influenzali del mondo, CSL Seqirus è un importante contributo alla prevenzione dell'influenza a livello globale e un partner transcontinentale nella preparazione pandemica. Con impianti di produzione all'avanguardia negli Stati Uniti, nel Regno Unito e in Australia, CSL Seqirus utilizza tecnologie di uovo, cellulare e adiuvante per offrire un ampio portafoglio di vaccini influenzali differenziati in più di 20 paesi in tutto il mondo. Per saperne di più su CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus e CSL Viper visita https://www.csl.com/ e CSL Plasma all'indirizzo https://www.cslplasma.com/ . I nostri vantaggi Per ulteriori informazioni sui vantaggi CSL visita Come CSL supporta il tuo benessere | CSL . Tu sei lungo alla CSL A CSL, Inclusione e Belonging è al centro della nostra missione e chi siamo. Esso alimenta la nostra innovazione giorno in e giorno fuori. Festeggiando le nostre differenze e creando una cultura della curiosità e dell'empatia, siamo in grado di comprendere meglio e connetterci con i nostri pazienti e donatori, promuovere relazioni forti con i nostri

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei der CSL glauben wir, dass unsere Leute unser wertvollstes Gut sind, um Leben zu retten und die Gesundheit der Menschen auf der ganzen Welt zu schützen. Als EMEA Total Rewards Partner ist es Ihr Ziel sicherzustellen, dass jedes Teammitglied in der ganzen Region für seinen Beitrag geschätzt und anerkannt wird. Durch die Verwaltung von wettbewerbsfähigen und fairen Rahmenbedingungen, Sie sind nicht nur auf der Suche nach Tabellenkalkulationen – Sie bauen die Grundlage, die unseren Wissenschaftlern und Fachleuten zu konzentrieren, was sie am besten tun: Bereitstellung lebenssparender Therapien für Patienten. Die Chance Dies ist eine sehr sichtbare Partnerrolle, in der Sie als Schlüsselberater in unserer gesamten Belohnungslandschaft fungieren werden. Sie werden nicht nur Pläne verwalten; Sie werden die strategische Brücke zwischen der globalen Strategie und der regionalen Ausführung sein. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit HR Business Partners und Business Leaders werden Sie die Komplexität verschiedener Arbeitsmärkte in der gesamten EMEA navigieren. Ihr Know-how wird darauf angewiesen sein, datengetriebene Erkenntnisse für komplexe Einstellungs- und Retentionsentscheidungen zu liefern, um sicherzustellen, dass CSL weiterhin ein Arbeitgeber der Wahl bleibt und unseren Mitarbeitern unser "Promise" durch ein umfassendes und attraktives Angebot hält. Hauptverantwortlichkeiten
• Strategisches Partnering: Als Fachexperte für HRBPs und Business Leaders fungieren und beratende, datengesteuerte Beratung für komplexe Herausforderungen bei der Entschädigung bieten.
• Regionales Programmmanagement: Umsetzung und Verwaltung der CSL-Belohnungsprogramme in der gesamten Region EMEA.
• Market Intelligence: Führende Beteiligung an der Analyse von Markttrends, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Belohnungsstrukturen wettbewerbsfähig und gerecht bleiben.
• Globale Ausrichtung: eng mit den Global Compensation, Benefits und Equity Teams zusammenarbeiten, um regionale Bedürfnisse zu gewährleisten, sind in unternehmensweiten Initiativen vertreten, einschließlich Workday-Kompensationszyklen.
• Compliance & Governance: Überwachung der gesetzlichen Anforderungen und Sicherstellung der Einhaltung der lokalen Arbeitsgesetze und der internen CSL-Governance. Anforderungen
• Qualifikationen: Ein Bachelor-Abschluss in Business, HR, Finance oder ein verwandten Bereich ist erforderlich. Berufszertifizierungen (z.B. CCP oder Äquivalent) werden hoch angesehen.
• Erfahrung: Bedeutende Erfahrung in der Vergütung und den Nutzen, insbesondere innerhalb einer großen, komplexen multinationalen Organisation in der gesamten Region EMEA.
• Systems Expertise: Starke Kenntnisse in HRIS-Plattformen (Arbeitstagsvorzug) und erweiterte Excel-Fähigkeiten für komplexe Datenmodellierung und -analyse.
• Kommunikation: Bewiesene Fähigkeit, komplexe Finanzdaten in klare, handlungsfähige Beratung für Stakeholder auf allen Ebenen zu übersetzen.
• Einflussnahme: Fähigkeit, Ansichten und Verhaltensweisen zu beeinflussen, um die geeigneten Belohnungsentscheidungen innerhalb der CSL zu gewährleisten Sprachen: Fluency in English ist essentiell; jedoch ist eine starke professionelle Leistungsfähigkeit in mindestens einer zusätzlichen europäischen Sprache sehr bevorzugt, um effektiv in unserem vielfältigen regionalen Fußabdruck zusammenzuarbeiten. Über CSL Seqirus CSL Seqirus ist Teil der CSL. Als einer der größten Influenza-Impfstoff-Anbieter der Welt ist CSL Seqirus ein wichtiger Beitrag zur Verhinderung der Influenza weltweit und eines transkontinentalen Partners in der pandemischen Bereitschaft. Mit modernsten Produktionsanlagen in den USA, den USA und Australien nutzt CSL Seqirus Ei-, Zell- und Adjuvanttechnologien, um ein breites Portfolio von differenzierten Influenza-Impfstoffen in mehr als 20 Ländern weltweit anzubieten. Weitere Informationen zu CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus und CSL Vifor finden Sie unter http://www.csl.com/ und CSL Plasma unter http://www.cslplasma.com/ . Unsere Vorteile Für weitere Informationen zu CSL-Leistungen besuchen Wie CSL unterstützt Ihr Wohlbefinden | CSL . Indem wir unsere Unterschiede feiern und eine Kultur der Neugier und Empathie schaffen, sind wir in der Lage, besser zu verstehen und mit unseren Patienten und Spendern zu verbinden, starke Beziehungen zu unseren
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez CSL, nous croyons que notre peuple est notre atout le plus précieux dans notre quête de sauver des vies et de protéger la santé des gens du monde entier. En tant que partenaire EMEA Total Rewards , votre objectif est de vous assurer que chaque membre de l'équipe de la région se sent valorisé et reconnu pour sa contribution. En gérant des cadres concurrentiels et équitables, vous ne vous contentez pas de regarder des feuilles de calcul, vous construisez la fondation qui permet à nos scientifiques et professionnels de se concentrer sur ce qu'ils font de mieux : fournir des thérapies vitales aux patients. L'opportunité Il s'agit d'un rôle de partenaire très visible où vous agirez comme conseiller clé dans notre paysage de récompenses. Vous ne vous contenterez pas d'administrer des plans; vous serez le pont stratégique entre la stratégie globale et l'exécution régionale. En étroite collaboration avec les partenaires des RH et les chefs d'entreprise, vous naviguerez dans la complexité de divers marchés du travail à travers l'EMEA. Votre expertise sera mise à profit pour fournir des informations basées sur les données pour les décisions complexes d'embauche et de maintien en poste, en veillant à ce que CSL reste un employeur de choix tout en maintenant notre « Promise » pour nos employés grâce à une offre complète et attrayante. Principales responsabilités
• Partenariats stratégiques : agir en tant qu'expert spécialisé dans la matière pour les HRBP et les chefs d'entreprise, en fournissant des conseils consultatifs et axés sur les données pour résoudre les problèmes complexes de rémunération.
• Gestion des programmes régionaux: Mise en oeuvre et gestion de programmes de récompense des CSL dans toute la région de l'EMEA.
• Intelligence du marché: une participation de premier plan à l'analyse des tendances du marché pour garantir que nos structures de récompense restent compétitives et équitables.
• Alignement global : Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes mondiales de rémunération, d'avantages sociaux et d'équité pour s'assurer que les besoins régionaux sont représentés dans les initiatives à l'échelle de l'entreprise, y compris les cycles de rémunération journaliers.
• Conformité et gouvernance: Superviser les exigences légales et veiller à ce que toutes les pratiques salariales respectent les lois locales du travail et la gouvernance interne des CSL. Exigences
• Qualifications: Un baccalauréat en affaires, RH, finances ou un domaine connexe est requis. Les certifications professionnelles (p. ex. CCP ou équivalent) sont très appréciées.
• Expérience: Expérience significative en rémunération et avantages sociaux, en particulier au sein d'une grande organisation multinationale complexe dans toute la région de l'EMEA.
• Expertise en systèmes : Bonne maîtrise des plateformes HRIS (de préférence pour les journées de travail) et compétences Excel avancées pour la modélisation et l'analyse de données complexes.
• Communication: Capacité éprouvée de traduire des données financières complexes en conseils clairs et concrets à tous les niveaux.
• Influencer : Capacité d'influencer les opinions et les comportements pour s'assurer que les décisions de récompense appropriées sont prises au sein du CSL Langues: La maîtrise de l'anglais est essentielle; cependant, une forte compétence professionnelle dans au moins une langue européenne supplémentaire est très préférable à un partenariat efficace sur toute notre diversité régionale. À propos de CSL Seqirus CSL Seqirus fait partie de CSL. En tant que l'un des plus grands fournisseurs de vaccins antigrippaux au monde, CSL Seqirus contribue de façon importante à la prévention de la grippe à l'échelle mondiale et est un partenaire transcontinental dans la préparation aux pandémies. Avec des installations de production ultramodernes aux États-Unis, au Royaume-Uni et en Australie, CSL Seqirus utilise des technologies d'ovules, de cellules et d'adjuvants pour offrir un large éventail de vaccins antigrippaux différenciés dans plus de 20 pays du monde. Pour en savoir plus sur CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus et CSL Vifor, visitez https://www.csl.com/ et CSL Plasma à https://www.cslplasma.com/ . Nos avantages Pour plus d'information sur les avantages de la LSC, visitez Comment la LSC soutient votre bien-être. Vous appartenez à CSL Chez CSL, l'inclusion et l'appartenance sont au cœur de notre mission et de ce que nous sommes. Elle alimente notre journée de l'innovation au quotidien. En célébrant nos différences et en créant une culture de curiosité et d'empathie, nous sommes en mesure de mieux comprendre nos patients et nos donneurs et d'établir des liens plus étroits avec eux

jobs.title: Global OT Partner Enablement
jobs.description:
The Opportunity:

• The Global OT Partner Enablement Lead is accountable for establishing and governing the strategic technical framework by which external partners deliver operational and capital OT services across GxP manufacturing and laboratory systems, including PCS, MES, OSI PI, and LIMS platforms.

• This role provides global governance for the technical aspects of supplier relationships, ensuring that master service agreements, quality plans, service agreements, maintenance agreements, partner KPIs, and platform lifecycle commitments are aligned to the enterprise OT strategy and consistently applied across all sites.

• Additionally, this role is responsible for defining and managing the shared services operating model for OT partners, including enterprise services management and the global T1 project contracting templates used across all platforms, and for coordinating closely with functional contract owners so that partner performance, scope, and deliverables support reliable, compliant, and cost-effective execution of both operational support and capital project work throughout the OT ecosystem.

The Role:

• Global OT Partner Governance & Shared Service Model -

• Establish and maintain the global governance framework for OT partners, including strategic platform providers, strategic suppliers and shared service delivery models.

• Define roles, responsibilities, and interfaces between Tier 1 partners, shared services, and internal teams to avoid overlap and gaps.

• Ensure partner governance practices (reviews, escalations, approvals) are consistently applied across all regions and sites.

• Drive adherence in collaboration with DQ and CSV to GxP, safety, and regulatory expectations in all partner-delivered services and projects.

• Enterprise Services & Shared Services Structure-

• Design and oversee the shared services structure for OT partner-delivered services (run, maintain, enhance) across PCS, MES, OSI PI, LIMS, and related platforms.

• Define the global OT service catalog, SLAs/KPIs, and RACI for internal teams, shared services, and external partners.

• Coordinate with global and site stakeholders to ensure services are right-sized, sustainable, and cost-effective.

• Monitor service performance data and drive improvements in reliability, responsiveness, and quality of shared and partner-delivered services.

• Contracting, MSAs & Project Templates-

• Own and maintain global master service agreements, quality plans, service agreements, and maintenance agreements for strategic OT partners and shared services.

• Develop, standardize, and continuously improve project contracting templates for use across all OT platforms and project types.

• Partner with At-site E&M, Legal, Procurement, and functional contract owners to ensure contracts clearly define scope, deliverables, compliance, and pricing structures.

• Periodically review and refresh contract terms to reflect evolving business needs, risk posture, and partner performance.

• Partner Project Delivery Management-

• Oversee partner project delivery quality for OT-related operational and capital projects, ensuring adherence to global standards, templates, and governance.

• Establish expectations for partner project governance, documentation, testing, and handover to operations for all partner-led projects.

• Capture and feed partner related project lessons learned into global standards, templates, and partner governance processes.

• Platform Lifecycle & Enterprise Alignment-

• Ensure partner and shared service agreements support the full lifecycle of OT platforms (introduction, expansion, upgrades, decommissioning).

• Align partner responsibilities with platform roadmaps for PCS, MES, OSI PI, LIMS, and other OT enterprise applications.

• Coordinate with OT Architecture, I&T, and platform owners to confirm lifecycle activities are contractually defined, resourced, and scheduled.

• Track execution of lifecycle activities and drive corrective act
