jobs.title: Laboratory Specialist, Tech Ops
jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Laboratory Specialist, Tech Ops supports day‑to‑day laboratory operations and technical activities that enable development, characterization, optimization, and lifecycle management of therapeutic products and associated processes. The role performs routine and moderately complex laboratory tasks, generates high‑quality data, and ensures that all work is conducted in alignment with established procedures, quality standards, and regulatory expectations.
The incumbent applies foundational scientific knowledge and practical laboratory skills to contribute to experimental execution, equipment operation, data documentation, and troubleshooting under guidance from more senior colleagues. The role collaborates within an Integrated Product Team (IPT) and with cross‑functional partners to ensure reliable laboratory operations and support program objectives across early development, late‑stage readiness, and commercial support activities.

Operating within a matrix environment, the Laboratory Specialist maintains a safe and compliant laboratory, supports continuous improvement initiatives, and contributes to day‑to‑day technical execution that enables robust product and process understanding.

Responsibilities

• Perform routine laboratory work, including sample preparation, execution of test methods or experimental tasks, and operation of laboratory equipment according to established procedures.

• Ensure timely, accurate, and contemporaneous documentation of all laboratory activities in Electronic Laboratory Notebook (ELN) systems and other electronic data‑capture tools, maintaining full compliance with data‑integrity and documentation standards.

• Support basic troubleshooting of laboratory methods, equipment, and workflows under the direction of senior team members.

• Contribute to accurate and reliable data generation; perform preliminary data checks and communicate observations to supervisors or project leads.

• Participate in deviations, investigations, and change control inputs by providing factual information, supporting documentation, and technical observations

• Collaborate within the IPT and across Tech Ops functions to support development, technology transfer, operational execution, and lifecycle management activities.

• Uphold safety standards, ensuring adherence to EHS policies, proper handling of materials, and compliance with training requirements

• Identify opportunities for improving workflows, documentation, and operational efficiency within the laboratory.

Education & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant scientific or technical discipline (e.g., biotechnology, biochemistry, engineering, life sciences) or equivalent practical laboratory experience.

• Up to 2 years of laboratory experience gained through industry, academia, internships, or practical coursework.

• Awareness of laboratory safety standards, basic scientific principles, and good documentation practices.

• Familiarity with common laboratory equipment and techniques (e.g., pH measurement, pipetting, centrifugation, chromatography).

• Strong attention to detail, reliability, and commitment to quality.

• Ability to learn new laboratory methods quickly and work effectively under moderate supervision.

• Good communication skills and willingness to collaborate within teams.

• Demonstrated motivation to contribute to continuous improvement and laboratory excellence.

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which produ

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sintesi del lavoro Il Laboratorio Specialist, Tech Ops supporta le operazioni di laboratorio quotidiane e le attività tecniche che consentono lo sviluppo, la caratterizzazione, l'ottimizzazione e la gestione del ciclo di vita dei prodotti terapeutici e dei processi associati. Il ruolo svolge compiti di laboratorio di routine e moderatamente complessi, genera dati di alta qualità, e assicura che tutto il lavoro sia condotto in allineamento con procedure consolidate, standard di qualità e aspettative normative. L'incumbent applica conoscenze scientifiche fondamentali e competenze di laboratorio pratiche per contribuire all'esecuzione sperimentale, al funzionamento delle attrezzature, alla documentazione dei dati e alla risoluzione dei problemi sotto la guida di colleghi più anziani. Il ruolo collabora all'interno di un gruppo di prodotti integrato (IPT) e con partner interfunzionali per garantire operazioni di laboratorio affidabili e sostenere obiettivi di programma attraverso le attività di sviluppo precoce, la prontezza del tardo stadio e il supporto commerciale. Operando all'interno di un ambiente matrice, il Laboratorio Specialist mantiene un laboratorio sicuro e conforme, supporta iniziative di miglioramento continuo e contribuisce all'esecuzione tecnica quotidiana che consente una solida comprensione del prodotto e del processo. responsabilità
• Eseguire lavori di laboratorio di routine, compresa la preparazione del campione, l'esecuzione di metodi di prova o compiti sperimentali, e il funzionamento di apparecchiature di laboratorio secondo procedure stabilite.
• Assicurare la documentazione tempestiva, accurata e contemporanea di tutte le attività di laboratorio nei sistemi Electronic Laboratory Notebook (ELN) e di altri strumenti elettronici di data-capture, mantenendo la piena conformità con gli standard di data-integrity e documentazione.
• Sostenere la risoluzione dei problemi di base dei metodi di laboratorio, delle attrezzature e dei flussi di lavoro sotto la direzione dei membri del team senior.
• Contribuire alla generazione di dati accurata e affidabile; eseguire controlli preliminari dei dati e comunicare osservazioni ai supervisori o ai lead del progetto.
• Partecipare a deviazioni, indagini e cambiamenti di input di controllo fornendo informazioni di fatto, supporto della documentazione e osservazioni tecniche
• Collaborare all'interno delle funzioni IPT e Tech Ops per supportare lo sviluppo, il trasferimento tecnologico, l'esecuzione operativa e le attività di gestione del ciclo di vita.
• Mantenere gli standard di sicurezza, garantire l'adesione alle politiche EHS, la corretta gestione dei materiali e il rispetto dei requisiti di formazione
• Identificare le opportunità per migliorare i flussi di lavoro, la documentazione e l'efficienza operativa all'interno del laboratorio. Istruzione e esperienza
• Corso di laurea in una disciplina scientifica o tecnica rilevante (ad esempio, biotecnologia, biochimica, ingegneria, scienze della vita) o equivalente esperienza di laboratorio pratico.
• Fino a 2 anni di esperienza di laboratorio acquisita attraverso industria, accademia, stage, o corsi pratici.
• Consapevolezza degli standard di sicurezza di laboratorio, principi scientifici di base e buone pratiche di documentazione.
• Familiarità con attrezzature e tecniche di laboratorio comuni (ad esempio, misurazione del pH, pipettaggio, centrifugazione, cromatografia).
• Forte attenzione ai dettagli, all'affidabilità e all'impegno per la qualità.
• Capacità di apprendere rapidamente nuovi metodi di laboratorio e di lavorare efficacemente sotto moderata supervisione.
• Buona capacità di comunicazione e disponibilità a collaborare all'interno dei team.
• Motivazione dimostrata per contribuire al miglioramento continuo e all'eccellenza del laboratorio. Informazioni su CSL Behring CSL Behring è un leader globale di biotherapeutics guidato dalla nostra promessa di salvare vite. Concentrati sulle esigenze dei pazienti utilizzando le più recenti tecnologie, scopriamo, sviluppiamo e forniamo terapie innovative per le persone che vivono con condizioni di immunologia, ematologia, cardiovascolare e metabolica, respiratoria e trapianto aree terapeutiche. Utilizziamo tre piattaforme scientifiche strategiche di frazionamento del plasma, tecnologia delle proteine ricombinanti e terapia cellulare e genica per supportare l'innovazione continua e perfezionare continuamente i modi in cui il prodotto

descriptionByLocale.de:
Zusammenfassung Der Laborspezialist Tech Ops unterstützt tägliche Laboroperationen und technische Aktivitäten, die die Entwicklung, Charakterisierung, Optimierung und Lifecycle-Management von therapeutischen Produkten und damit verbundenen Prozessen ermöglichen. Die Rolle führt routinemäßige und mäßig komplexe Laboraufgaben durch, erzeugt hochwertige Daten und stellt sicher, dass alle Arbeiten im Einklang mit etablierten Verfahren, Qualitätsstandards und regulatorischen Erwartungen durchgeführt werden. Der Auftraggeber wendet grundlegende wissenschaftliche Kenntnisse und praktische Laborkenntnisse an, um zur experimentellen Ausführung, zum Gerätebetrieb, zur Datendokumentation und zur Fehlerbehebung unter Anleitung von höheren Kollegen beizutragen. Die Rolle arbeitet in einem integrierten Produktteam (IPT) und mit funktionsübergreifenden Partnern zusammen, um zuverlässige Laboroperationen zu gewährleisten und Programmziele im Bereich der Frühentwicklung, der späten Bereitschaft und der kommerziellen Unterstützung zu unterstützen. Der Laborspezialist unterhält innerhalb einer Matrixumgebung ein sicheres und konformes Labor, unterstützt kontinuierliche Verbesserungsinitiativen und trägt zur täglichen technischen Durchführung bei, die ein robustes Produkt- und Prozessverständnis ermöglicht. Aufgaben
• Durchführung routinemäßiger Laborarbeiten, einschließlich Probenvorbereitung, Durchführung von Testmethoden oder experimentellen Aufgaben und Betrieb von Laborgeräten nach etablierten Verfahren.
• Gewährleistung einer rechtzeitigen, präzisen und gleichzeitigen Dokumentation aller Laboraktivitäten in den elektronischen Labor-Notizbüchern (ELN) Systemen und anderen elektronischen Datenerfassungswerkzeugen, wobei die Einhaltung der Datenschutz- und Dokumentationsstandards gewährleistet ist.
• Unterstützung der grundlegenden Fehlerbehebung von Labormethoden, Geräten und Workflows unter der Leitung von Senior Teammitgliedern.
• Beitrag zur genauen und zuverlässigen Datengenerierung; Durchführung vorläufiger Datenüberprüfungen und Übermittlung von Beobachtungen an Aufsichtspersonen oder Projektleiter.
• Beteiligen Sie sich an Abweichungen, Untersuchungen und Änderungen der Kontrollinputs, indem Sie sachliche Informationen, Dokumentationen und technische Beobachtungen bereitstellen
• Zusammenarbeit innerhalb des IPT und über Tech Ops Funktionen zur Unterstützung von Entwicklung, Technologietransfer, operativer Ausführung und Lebenszyklusmanagement-Aktivitäten.
• Einhaltung der Sicherheitsstandards, Sicherstellung der Einhaltung der EHS-Richtlinien, der ordnungsgemäßen Handhabung von Materialien und der Einhaltung der Ausbildungsanforderungen
• Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung von Arbeitsabläufen, Dokumentationen und betrieblicher Effizienz im Labor identifizieren. Bildung und Erfahrung
• Bachelor-Abschluss in einer relevanten wissenschaftlichen oder technischen Disziplin (z.B. Biotechnologie, Biochemie, Ingenieurwesen, Life Sciences) oder gleichwertige Praxiserfahrung.

jobs.description:
The Opportunity

The Senior Manager, Total Rewards – EMEA is an experienced compensation professional and recognized subject matter expert within CSL’s Total Rewards organization. In this role, you will provide advanced professional expertise and consultative compensation support across the EMEA region, partnering closely with HR Business Partners, business leaders, and global Total Rewards colleagues.

This position supports the planning, design, and execution of compensation programs across diverse and complex labor markets. You will lead sophisticated analytical work—such as job evaluation, market pricing, salary structure management, and survey participation—while ensuring alignment with global reward strategies, regional business priorities, and local regulatory requirements. Acting as a key connector between global strategy and regional execution, you will help enable sound, competitive, and compliant reward decisions across EMEA.

Key Responsibilities

• Serve as a trusted compensation subject matter expert for HR Business Partners and business leaders across EMEA, providing consultative guidance on complex reward topics.

• Support regional compensation planning and execution, including base pay, incentives, hiring offers, retention scenarios, and ad‑hoc business needs, in line with global frameworks and local market practices.

• Implement and maintain compensation programs across EMEA, balancing local requirements with global standards and governance.

• Deliver advanced compensation analytics—such as market benchmarking, equity reviews, pay positioning, and scenario modelling—and translate insights into practical recommendations.

• Prepare clear and well‑structured analytical and presentation materials to support compensation discussions and decision‑making.

• Partner with the Regional Total Rewards Lead and Global Compensation, Benefits, and Equity teams on enterprise‑wide initiatives and Workday‑driven processes.

• Support job evaluation, leveling, and job architecture activities aligned with CSL’s Career Framework.

• Provide compensation input to organizational changes and growth initiatives, support pay transparency readiness across EMEA, and ensure compliance with internal policies, governance standards, and local labor laws, while building effective stakeholder relationships.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Human Resources, or a related field (Master’s degree preferred).

• 7+ years of progressive experience in Compensation within a medium to large, complex multinational organization, ideally with EMEA exposure, and a strong foundation in job architecture, market pricing, salary structures, and incentive support.

• Solid understanding of the broader Total Rewards and benefits landscape; consulting or advisory experience (internal or external) is highly desirable.

• Sound business acumen with the ability to interpret compensation topics within a broader organizational and commercial context.

• Strong analytical capability, with experience translating complex market, financial, and internal data into clear, practical insights and recommendations.

• Clear, credible business‑facing communication skills, with the ability to influence through collaboration and evidence‑based analysis.

• Solid financial and numerical reasoning skills, supported by strong proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint.

• Comfortable operating in ambiguity and fast‑paced, evolving environments, with a collaborative, pragmatic, and solutions‑oriented approach.

• Fluency in English is essential; professional proficiency in at least one additional European language is highly preferred.

jobs.title: Global Product Leader
jobs.description:
Global Product Leader
Some roles exist to manage processes. This one exists to make consequential decisions about medicines that matter to patients with serious diseases — and to ensure those decisions are made well, at pace, and with the full weight of evidence behind them.
CSL Behring is seeking a Global Product Leader (GPL) to take end-to-end ownership of a late-stage development asset, from late research transition through development, commercialization, and lifecycle management. The accountability is real: for strategy, for delivery, and for the value the asset creates across its lifetime.

The Role
As GPL, you will sit on the Therapeutic Area Leadership Team and represent the asset at CSL's most senior governance forums. You will lead a global, cross-functional Product Strategy Team — bringing together clinical, regulatory, commercial, manufacturing, and scientific expertise into a coherent, executable plan. You will own the asset strategy, drive it through governance with clear, well-framed recommendations, and ensure the organization moves decisively when decisions are needed.
The scope is broad. You will integrate competitive intelligence, payer dynamics, patient insights, and evolving clinical data into strategic trade-offs. You will lead lifecycle value creation — label expansions, new indications, geographic reach. You will represent CSL externally, including in due diligence and partnership contexts. Your thinking will be tested by people who know the science, the market, and the economics — and it needs to hold up.
Leadership here means influence rather than line authority: building alignment across functions and sustaining it through organizational complexity, competing priorities, and the inevitable turbulence of long development programs.

What You'll Be Responsible For
You will own the Product Strategy Plan and keep it current as data and conditions evolve — balancing honest advocacy for the asset with the objectivity to adjust when the evidence calls for it. You will prepare governance bodies to make good decisions by giving them well-structured options, clear trade-offs, and a recommendation you're willing to defend. You will anticipate risks and surface them early, rather than letting surprises reach the wrong moment.

This one exists to make consequential decisions about medicines that matter to patients with serious diseases — and to ensure those decisions are made well, at pace, and with the full weight of evidence behind them. CSL Behring is seeking a Global Product Leader (GPL) to take end-to-end ownership of a late-stage development asset, from late research transition through development, commercialization, and lifecycle management. The accountability is real: for strategy, for delivery, and for the value the asset creates across its lifetime. The Role As GPL, you will sit on the Therapeutic Area Leadership Team and represent the asset at CSL's most senior governance forums. You will lead a global, cross-functional Product Strategy Team — bringing together clinical, regulatory, commercial, manufacturing, and scientific expertise into a coherent, executable plan. You will own the asset strategy, drive it through governance with clear, well-framed recommendations, and ensure the organization moves decisively when decisions are needed. The scope is broad. You will integrate competitive intelligence, payer dynamics, patient insights, and evolving clinical data into strategic trade-offs. You will lead lifecycle value creation — label expansions, new indications, geographic reach. You will represent CSL externally, including in due diligence and partnership contexts. Your thinking will be tested by people who know the science, the market, and the economics — and it needs to hold up. Leadership here means influence rather than line authority: building alignment across functions and sustaining it through organizational complexity, competing priorities, and the inevitable turbulence of long development programs. jobs.description:
CSL's R&D organization is accelerating innovation to deliver greater impact for patients. With a project-led structure and a focus on collaboration, we’re building a future-ready team that thrives in dynamic biotech ecosystems. Joining CSL now means being part of an agile team committed to developing therapies that make a meaningful difference worldwide.

We are currently looking for an Associate Director, Non-Clinical Pharmacology - CVR to join our team in Schlieren, Zurich.

Key Tasks

• Design and implement study protocols for nonclinical pharmacology studies with a particular focus on PK/PD and efficacy studies in translational models of disease in Cardiovascular and Renal indications

• Work closely with PK, Toxicology and Translational Science to integrate nonclinical pharmacology plans into a broader drug discovery plan to support effective project stage transitions and decision making

• Collaborate with internal teams, academic collaborators or CROs to ensure high-quality, timely execution of pharmacology studies and organizational alignment on key Go/No Go criteria

• Engage with and manage outside vendors and partners, including guidance and review of experiments conducted by third party vendors

• Participate in project teams and provide expert input on nonclinical pharmacology strategy and execution

• Prepare study reports, presentations, and present findings to internal stakeholders and external collaborators as needed

• Contribute to regulatory documents for IND submission

• Foster a culture of scientific excellence, psychological safety, innovation, and continuous growth

Your Profile

• Ph.D. in Pharmacology, Physiology, Biomedical Sciences, or a related field.

• 5+ years of experience in nonclinical pharmacology within the pharmaceutical or biotech industry with proven understanding of drug discovery and pharmaceutical development

• Expertise in in vivo pharmacology, disease models, and translational science for the relevant TA (Cardiovascular and/or Renal Disease Biology).

• Experience across multiple therapeutic areas and modalities is highly desirable Proven ability to work in project teams and to manage multiple projects and timelines

Are you interested? We are looking forward to receiving your online application.

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

Our Benefits
For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL .

You Belong at CSL
At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakeholders, and sustain a diverse workforce that will move our company and industry into the future.
To learn more about inclusion and belonging visit https://www.csl.com/careers/inclusion-and-belonging

jobs.description:
The Opportunity:

• The Global Reliability Engineering Lead provides enterprise leadership for asset reliability, maintenance excellence, and engineering rigor across all CSL Behring manufacturing sites.

• This role drives global standardization of reliability methodologies, ensures consistency in maintenance work processes, and strengthens long-term asset performance.

• The position serves as a strategic partner to site reliability teams and centers of excellence by setting global expectations, supporting technical capability development, and promoting practices that improve equipment performance, reduce risk, and safeguard business continuity.

• All responsibilities must be executed in alignment with CSL’s patient-focused mission and Core Values, and with a high level of integrity, collaboration, and cultural awareness.

The Role:

• Global Reliability Framework and Direction -

• Establish and maintain the global reliability strategy that supports asset lifecycle performance, operational continuity, and alignment with CSL engineering standards.

• Develop standardized reliability frameworks, tools, and metrics that strengthen work process discipline across all manufacturing sites.

• Conduct global assessments to identify gaps, benchmark best practices, and ensure consistent application of reliability fundamentals.

• Monitor global KPIs related to asset reliability, maintenance efficiency, and operational risk, and communicate insights to site and regional leadership.

• Ensure adherence to regulatory expectations and internal quality requirements across all reliability-related activities.

• Technical Leadership and Engineering Excellence-

• Provide expert technical guidance for complex equipment challenges and high-risk investigations across the global network.

• Facilitate and mentor site teams in methods such as RCM, FMEA, RCA, predictive diagnostics, and other reliability engineering principles.

• Support the evaluation of new technologies, materials, and design approaches to ensure maintainability, reliability, and cost effectiveness.

• Review equipment installation, commissioning, and qualification plans to ensure alignment with asset lifecycle requirements.

• Drive improvement in preventive and predictive maintenance programs, including the use of advanced diagnostic tools.

• Global Collaboration and Capability Building-

• Partner with site engineering, maintenance, operations, quality, EHS, and OpEx teams to build shared understanding of reliability objectives and to strengthen network alignment.

• Lead global workshops, training programs, and knowledge sharing forums that build technical capability in reliability engineering.

• Support the development of global learning materials for maintenance engineering functions and ensure consistent training across sites.

• Promote open communication, cross-functional engagement, and collaborative problem-solving across regional and global teams.

• Demonstrate flexibility in work hours to support global stakeholders in different time zones.

• People and Culture Expectations -

• Reinforce CSL’s Core Values of Patient Focus, Innovation, Integrity, Collaboration, and Superior Performance in all interactions.

• Serve as a cultural ambassador who models professionalism, ethical behavior, sound judgment, and inclusive collaboration.

• Support global safety expectations by consistently using required PPE when on site and complying with occupational health and safety practices.

• Other Responsibilities-

• Foster a respectful and positive environment where continuous improvement, accountability, and learning are encouraged.

• Provide technical input during capital project reviews related to maintainability, reliability risk, and long term asset performance.

• Participate in audits, inspections, and program reviews to ensure compliance and drive continuous improvement.

• Contribute to strategic initiatives and business priorities led by global engineering or Ka

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione L'opportunità: - Il Global Reliability Engineering Lead fornisce la leadership aziendale per l'affidabilità, l'eccellenza della manutenzione e il rigore ingegneristico in tutti i siti di produzione CSL Behring. - Questo ruolo guida la standardizzazione globale delle metodologie di affidabilità, assicura la coerenza nei processi di manutenzione e rafforza le prestazioni di asset a lungo termine. - La posizione funge da partner strategico per team di affidabilità del sito e centri di eccellenza impostando aspettative globali, supportando lo sviluppo delle capacità tecniche e promuovendo pratiche che migliorano le prestazioni delle attrezzature, riducono il rischio e salvaguardano la continuità aziendale. - Tutte le responsabilità devono essere eseguite in allineamento con la missione focalizzata sul paziente e i valori fondamentali della CSL, e con un alto livello di integrità, collaborazione e consapevolezza culturale. Il ruolo: - Global Reliability Framework and Direction - - Stabilire e mantenere la strategia di affidabilità globale che supporta le prestazioni del ciclo di vita degli asset, la continuità operativa e l'allineamento con gli standard di ingegneria CSL. - Sviluppare framework, strumenti e metriche di affidabilità standardizzati che rafforzano la disciplina del processo di lavoro in tutti i siti di produzione. - Condurre valutazioni globali per identificare lacune, best practice di benchmark e garantire l'applicazione coerente dei fondamentali di affidabilità. - Monitorare i KPI globali relativi all'affidabilità degli asset, all'efficienza di manutenzione e al rischio operativo, e comunicare intuizioni alla leadership del sito e regionale. - Assicurare l'adesione alle aspettative normative e ai requisiti di qualità interna in tutte le attività correlate all'affidabilità. - Leadership tecnica e ingegneria eccellenza- - Fornire una guida tecnica esperta per complesse sfide e indagini ad alto rischio in tutta la rete globale. - Facilitate e tutor team di siti in metodi come RCM, FMEA, RCA, diagnostica predittiva e altri principi di ingegneria di affidabilità. - Supporta la valutazione di nuove tecnologie, materiali e approcci di progettazione per garantire la manutenbilità, l'affidabilità e l'efficacia dei costi. - Verificare l'installazione, la messa in servizio e i piani di qualificazione per garantire l'allineamento con i requisiti del ciclo di vita degli asset. - Miglioramento dell'azionamento nei programmi di manutenzione preventiva e predittiva, compreso l'uso di strumenti diagnostici avanzati. - Global Collaboration and Capability Building- - Partner con i team di progettazione, manutenzione, operazioni, qualità, EHS e OpEx per la comprensione condivisa degli obiettivi di affidabilità e per rafforzare l'allineamento della rete. - Condurre workshop globali, programmi di formazione e forum di condivisione delle conoscenze che costruiscono capacità tecniche nell'ingegneria dell'affidabilità. - Sostenere lo sviluppo di materiali di apprendimento globali per le funzioni di ingegneria della manutenzione e garantire una formazione coerente tra i siti. - Promuovere la comunicazione aperta, l'impegno interfunzionale e la risoluzione dei problemi collaborativi tra team regionali e globali. - Dimostrare flessibilità nelle ore di lavoro per sostenere gli stakeholder globali in diverse fusi orari. - Persone e culture - - Rinforzare i valori fondamentali della CSL del focus paziente, innovazione, integrità, collaborazione e prestazioni superiori in tutte le interazioni. - Servire come ambasciatore culturale che modella professionalità, comportamento etico, giudizio sonoro e collaborazione inclusiva. - Sostenere le aspettative di sicurezza globali utilizzando costantemente PPE richiesto quando sul posto e rispettare le pratiche di salute e sicurezza sul lavoro. - Altre responsabilità - Promuovere un ambiente rispettoso e positivo in cui vengono incoraggiati continui miglioramenti, responsabilità e apprendimento. - Fornire input tecnici durante le recensioni dei progetti di capitale relativi a manutenbilità, rischio di affidabilità e prestazioni di asset a lungo termine. - Partecipare a audit, ispezioni e recensioni di programmi per garantire la conformità e guidare il miglioramento continuo. - Contribuire a iniziative strategiche e priorità di business guidate dall'ingegneria globale o da Ka

jobs.title: GRA CMC Specialist
jobs.description:
Position Purpose

Partnering closely with global and regional Global Regulatory Affairs colleagues, as well as Global Operations stakeholders, to address regulatory strategy challenges and deliver innovative, timely regulatory CMC solutions that meet evolving regulatory and compliance requirements.

Supporting digital innovation, enabling capital project initiatives, and managing strategic external partnerships by coordinating and aligning regulatory CMC strategies and activities across the enterprise.

Ensuring operational alignment of Global Regulatory Affairs CMC activities and processes with R&D Global Regulatory Affairs and within Global Operations business needs.

This role promotes strong cross-functional collaboration and effective communication across Global Operations, R&D, Global Regulatory Affairs, and other relevant CSL business functions to drive alignment and support CSL’s strategic business objectives.

Main 
• Responsibilities and Accountabilities

Develop global regulatory CMC strategies for enterprise-wide CAPEX and compliance projects through collaboration with functional leaders in Global Regulatory Affairs CMC, Global Regulatory Affairs, R&D, Quality, Global Operations, and other business functions.

Assess and facilitate the use of digital innovation for Global Regulatory Affairs CMC, including AI/ML applications that manage or support regulatory submission, notification, assessment and intelligence activities. Collaborate with Procurement, IT, external vendors, and R&D Global Regulatory Affairs to implement next-generation solutions that enhance the generation of regulatory strategies and execution of regulatory operations. Define and monitor KPIs to measure impact of digital initiatives on operational efficiency indicators.

Manage relationships with outsourcing vendors to support global regulatory CMC activities. Serve as contact for external partners, coordinating deliverables, timelines, and compliance across multiple projects and geographies. Monitor performance, quality, KPIs, and regulatory readiness of outsourced operations, driving continuous improvement and risk mitigation strategies.

Monitor, interpret, and communicate evolving global CMC regulations (FDA, EMA, PMDA, NMPA, etc.). Ensure timely dissemination of regulatory intelligence to internal stakeholders and integration into strategic planning.

Coordinate key regulatory CMC activities for the Global Regulatory Affairs CMC organization, including change control, due diligence (for potential acquisitions, licensing, and partnerships), template management for quality CTD sections, deviation support, inspection support, and others.

Support the collaboration with CSL’s Corporate & External Affairs organization to support legislative and statutory initiatives to allow CSL to take an active leadership role in shaping policy and regulatory frameworks that impact the development, registration, and life-cycle management of plasma-derived therapies.

Support the development of strategic and tactical plans for Global Regulatory Affairs CMC, advising senior leadership on regulatory requirements and their implications for project timelines, compliance, and business strategy. Contribute to the evaluation of new business opportunities in collaboration with development teams.

Ensure regulatory policies and procedures are developed and implemented in accordance with applicable international standards and requirements.

Support the the creation and execution of regulatory policies, processes, and SOPs that meet global regulatory requirements while driving operational efficiency and effectiveness across Global Operations and its stakeholder network.

Support the execution of the outsourcing of regulatory activities, including performance monitoring and quality assurance, to ensure timely and compliant delivery of services aligned with business and regulatory requirements.

Position 
• Qualifications and Experience 
• Requirements

Education & Experience

A bachel

descriptionByLocale.it:
Oggetto CMC - Network Strategy & Operation è responsabile per: Collaborando a stretto contatto con i colleghi globali e regionali di regolamentazione globale, nonché con le parti interessate di Global Operations, per affrontare le sfide della strategia di regolamentazione e fornire soluzioni CMC normative innovative e tempestive che soddisfano i requisiti di regolamentazione e conformità in evoluzione. Sostenere l'innovazione digitale, abilitare iniziative di progetto di capitale e gestire partnership esterne strategiche coordinando e allineando le strategie e le attività regolamentari CMC in tutta l'azienda. Garantire l'allineamento operativo delle attività e dei processi di Global Regulatory Affairs CMC con R&D Global Regulatory Affairs e all'interno delle esigenze aziendali di Global Operations. Questo ruolo promuove una forte collaborazione interfunzionale e una comunicazione efficace attraverso Global Operations, R&D, Global Regulatory Affairs e altre funzioni aziendali CSL rilevanti per guidare l'allineamento e sostenere gli obiettivi strategici aziendali della CSL. Principali
• Responsabilità e responsabilità Sviluppare strategie CMC di regolamentazione globale per i progetti di conformità a livello aziendale e CAPEX attraverso la collaborazione con leader funzionali in Global Regulatory Affairs CMC, Global Regulatory Affairs, R&D, Quality, Global Operations e altre funzioni aziendali. Valuta e facilita l'uso dell'innovazione digitale per Global Regulatory Affairs CMC, comprese le applicazioni AI/ML che gestiscono o supportano le attività di presentazione, notifica, valutazione e intelligence. Collabora con Procurement, IT, fornitori esterni e R&D Global Regulatory Affairs per implementare soluzioni di nuova generazione che migliorano la generazione di strategie normative e l'esecuzione delle operazioni di regolazione. Definire e monitorare i KPI per misurare l'impatto delle iniziative digitali sugli indicatori di efficienza operativa. Gestisci i rapporti con i fornitori di outsourcing per supportare le attività CMC normative globali. Servire come contatto per i partner esterni, coordinare i responsabili, le linee temporali e la conformità tra più progetti e geografie. Monitorare le prestazioni, la qualità, i KPI e la disponibilità normativa di operazioni outsourced, guidando strategie di miglioramento continuo e mitigazione dei rischi. Monitorare, interpretare e comunicare le normative CMC globali in evoluzione (FDA, EMA, PMDA, NMPA, ecc.). Assicurare la diffusione tempestiva dell'intelligenza normativa agli stakeholder interni e l'integrazione nella pianificazione strategica. Coordinare le attività CMC di regolamentazione chiave per l'organizzazione Global Regulatory Affairs CMC, tra cui il controllo dei cambiamenti, due diligence (per potenziali acquisizioni, licenze e partenariati), la gestione dei modelli per le sezioni CTD di qualità, il supporto di deviazione, il supporto di ispezione e altri. Sostenere la collaborazione con l’organizzazione Corporate & External Affairs di CSL per sostenere iniziative legislative e statutarie per consentire alla CSL di assumere un ruolo di leadership attivo nella definizione di politiche e quadri normativi che influiscono sullo sviluppo, la registrazione e la gestione del ciclo di vita delle terapie basate sul plasma. Sostenere lo sviluppo di piani strategici e tattici per Global Regulatory Affairs CMC, consigliando la leadership senior sui requisiti normativi e le loro implicazioni per i tempi di progetto, la conformità e la strategia aziendale. Contribuisci alla valutazione di nuove opportunità di business in collaborazione con i team di sviluppo. Assicurarsi che le politiche e le procedure di regolamentazione siano sviluppate e implementate in conformità con le norme e i requisiti internazionali applicabili. Sostenere la creazione e l'esecuzione di politiche, processi e SOP normativi globali che soddisfano i requisiti normativi globali, guidando l'efficienza operativa e l'efficacia su Global Operations e sulla sua rete di stakeholder. Sostenere l'esecuzione dell'outsourcing delle attività regolamentari, compreso il monitoraggio delle prestazioni e la garanzia della qualità, per garantire la consegna tempestiva e conforme dei servizi allineati con le esigenze aziendali e regolamentari

Beitrag zur Bewertung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklungsteams. jobs.description:
For our global Technical Operations Organization, we are currently looking for a

Senior Laboratory Specialist – Analytical Testing (m/f/x)

Fullltime / Permanent / CF Level 04
Locations available: Bern

The Opportunity
Researches and develops innovative medicines to address unmet medical needs, from early discovery through clinical trials to commercialization. It ensures that all products meet the highest clinical safety standards and comply with global regulatory requirements. The role involves analyzing complex data, managing research processes, and maintaining technical documentation and systems. It also includes designing and implementing experimental and operational processes to support efficient product development and informed decision-making. In addition, the position leads projects and cross-functional teams, overseeing portfolio prioritization, resource allocation, and risk management. Finally, it contributes to the development and optimization of manufacturing processes to enable efficient, scalable, and compliant production.

Main Responsibilities and Accountabilities:

• Supports the team in leveraging technology platform capabilities to contribute to project goals.​

• Assists in the coordination of local and global research and development activities under guidance.​

• Participates in collaborative efforts with other CSL sites and external partners, with supervision.​

• Applies foundational knowledge of relevant scientific disciplines to support laboratory tasks and project execution.​

• Works under close to moderate supervision to meet operational objectives with limited impact on broader departmental outcomes.​

• Resolves routine problems and contributes to discussions on more complex issues with support from senior team members.​

• Communicates effectively within the team, sharing relevant information and adhering to established policies and procedures.

Your skills and experience

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant scientific discipline (e.g., molecular biology, cellular biology, biochemistry, or related field).​

• Up to 2 years of laboratory or research experience, including internships or academic lab work.​

• Familiarity with basic laboratory techniques and safety protocols.​

• Strong willingness to learn and grow within a collaborative research environment.

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

Our Benefits
For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL .

You Belong at CSL
At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakeholders, and sustain a diverse workforce that will move our company and industry into the future.
To learn more about inclusion and belonging visit https://www.csl.com/careers/inclusion-and-belonging

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione Per la nostra organizzazione operativa tecnica globale, stiamo attualmente cercando un Senior Laboratory Specialist – Testing analitico (m/f/x) Tempo pieno / Permanente / CF Livello 04 Località disponibili: Bern L'opportunità Ricerca e sviluppa farmaci innovativi per affrontare le esigenze mediche non misurate, dalla scoperta precoce attraverso studi clinici alla commercializzazione. Assicura che tutti i prodotti soddisfino i più elevati standard di sicurezza clinica e siano conformi ai requisiti normativi globali. Il ruolo consiste nell'analisi di dati complessi, nella gestione dei processi di ricerca e nel mantenimento della documentazione tecnica e dei sistemi. Esso comprende anche la progettazione e l'attuazione di processi sperimentali e operativi per sostenere lo sviluppo efficiente del prodotto e il processo decisionale informato. Inoltre, la posizione conduce progetti e team interfunzionali, supervisionando la priorità del portafoglio, l'allocazione delle risorse e la gestione dei rischi. Infine, contribuisce allo sviluppo e all'ottimizzazione dei processi produttivi per consentire una produzione efficiente, scalabile e conforme. jobs.description:
Researches and develops new medicines for unmet medical needs through innovative medical science from inception, through clinical trials to commercialization. Assesses, monitors and ensures products meet clinical safety standards. Conducts sophisticated analysis, manages research information systems and technical documentation. May be involved in providing para-professional laboratory support for product testing after collection. Establishes relationship with regulatory authorities to establish and maintain registration licenses to sell products globally.​

Designs and implements business experimental processes to enable product research and development. Designs related integrated process and candidate / product team activities and directs technical and operational activities to ensure planned project outcomes, and enables portfolio prioritization, resource allocation, and risk management. Provides and contributes to project progression and reports, as required, to project or program committees for decision-making support. Leads teams in the development of program and project strategy, and lifecycle management planning. Develops systems to support dynamic portfolio management. Serves a key role in portfolio evaluation process. Drives initiatives across research and development units to create fully integrated strategies. Monitors and reports on portfolio status and proactively addresses and resolves issues. May design and develop manufacturing processes for new or existing products, taking into consideration problems inherent in the transfer of technology from research to manufacturing. Develops procedures for the economical mass production in cooperation with pilot-plant and production departments. Conducts tests and measurements throughout stages of production to determine control over applicable variables. As required, will need to operate within the current regulatory and compliance environments.​

Main Responsibilities & Accountabilities​

• ​Contributes technology platform capabilities to team in order to achieve designated project objectives. ​

• Coordinates global and local research and development projects.​

• Manages collaboration with different CSL sites and external partners.​

• Applies practical knowledge of job area typically obtained through advanced education and work experience​

• Works independently with general supervision to achieve operational targets with direct impact on departmental results​

• Problems faced are difficult but typically not complex, sometimes requiring understanding of broader set of issues​

• May influence others within the job area through explanation of facts, policies, and practices​

Qualifications & Experience Requirements
​

• Bachelors or postgraduate degree and /or extensive experience in relevant discipline.​

• Minimum 3 years' laboratory experience with training in a relevant technical discipline e.g., molecular and cellular biology, analytical biochemistry etc.​

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com

jobs.description:
The Laboratory Coordinator, Tech Ops (Analytical Support) contributes to the execution of analytical activities that enable the characterization, monitoring, and lifecycle management of therapeutic products and associated processes. ​

The role performs routine analytical tasks, supports method execution, and ensures reliable data generation in alignment with established procedures, quality standards, and regulatory expectations.​

The incumbent applies basic scientific knowledge and practical laboratory skills to conduct laboratory analyses, operate instruments, and document results. Working under moderate supervision, the role supports analytical method execution across early development, late‑stage readiness, and commercial lifecycle activities. Operating within a matrix environment, the Laboratory Coordinator collaborates with the IPT and cross‑functional partners to ensure analytical readiness, consistent data quality, and effective laboratory operations that support technical decision‑making.​

Main Responsibilities & Accountabilities​

• Perform routine analytical testing according to SOPs, established test methods, and regulatory expectations.​

• Support sample preparation, instrument setup, system suitability checks, and execution of analytical workflows (e.g., chromatography, electrophoresis, spectroscopy).​

• Document all analytical activities accurately, contemporaneously, and in compliance with Good Documentation Practices (GDP).​

• Ensure timely, accurate, and contemporaneous documentation of all activities in Electronic Laboratory Notebook (ELN) systems and other electronic data‑capture tools, maintaining full compliance with data‑integrity standards.​

• Conduct basic troubleshooting of analytical methods and laboratory equipment under the direction of senior team members.​

• Perform preliminary data review, identify irregularities, and communicate observations promptly to supervisors or project leads.​

• Support method lifecycle activities including method qualification, optimization, and transfer tasks.​

• Maintain laboratory readiness, including equipment qualification support, ordering and managing consumables, and ensuring compliant laboratory conditions.​

• Provide factual inputs for deviations, investigations, CAPAs, and change control processes related to analytical work.​

• Collaborate with IPT and cross‑functional stakeholders (e.g., Process Development, MS&T, QC) to ensure robust analytical execution aligned with program objectives.​

• Uphold EHS standards and contribute to maintaining a safe, compliant, and well‑organized laboratory environment.​

• Identify opportunities to improve analytical workflows, documentation practices, and operational efficiency.​

Qualifications & Experience Requirements​

• Bachelor’s degree in Analytical Chemistry, Biochemistry, Life Sciences, or a related scientific discipline, or equivalent practical laboratory experience.​

• 3 years of laboratory experience in an analytical or process‑development environment (industry or academia).Foundational experience with analytical techniques such as HPLC/UPLC, CE, SDS‑PAGE, UV/Vis spectroscopy, or comparable platforms.​

• Awareness of analytical method execution principles, data‑integrity expectations, and regulated laboratory practices.​

• Strong attention to detail and demonstrated ability to generate reliable, high‑quality analytical data.​

• Ability to learn new analytical techniques and laboratory workflows quickly under moderate supervision.​

• Good communication skills and willingness to collaborate within multidisciplinary teams.​

• Demonstrated interest in continuous improvement and laboratory excellence..​

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascu

jobs.description:
For our global Technical Operations Organization, we are currently looking for a

Analytical Testing Lead / Principal Scientist (m/f/x)

Fullltime / Permanent / Closing date April 17th
Locations available: Bern

The Opportunity
This role drives the discovery and development of innovative medicines that address unmet medical needs, guiding projects from early research through clinical trials and toward global commercialization. It ensures the highest standards of clinical safety while managing advanced research analyses, information systems, and technical documentation. The position also supports laboratory activities and helps maintain regulatory approvals by collaborating closely with health authorities. Additionally, it provides expert scientific guidance, implements specialized technical capabilities, and contributes to rigorous experiment planning, execution, and reporting. The role further supports the growth of the R&D organization by training team members in key scientific and technological platforms.

Key Responsibilities:

• Leads the design, implementation, and optimization of advanced technical capabilities, guiding cross-functional teams to achieve complex research objectives within defined timelines

• Oversees the planning, execution, and interpretation of high-impact scientific experiments, ensuring the highest standards of scientific rigor and integrity

• Mentors and develops scientific staff, fostering technical growth and knowledge transfer across the organization

• Serves as a recognized authority in the field, contributing to scientific strategy, portfolio planning, and external collaborations

• Manages large-scale, cross-functional projects or programs with minimal oversight, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and regulatory expectations

• Solves complex, multi-dimensional problems requiring deep technical insight and cross-disciplinary collaboration

• Represents the organization in scientific forums, publications, and external partnerships, enhancing visibility and thought leadership

Your skills and experience

• PhD in a scientific discipline

• Typically, 5–8 years of related experience

• Track record of scientific achievement in relevant Life Sciences discipline

• Mastery of advanced methodologies

• Oversight of research cross-functional teams and initiatives

• Setting direction for scientific programs

• Excellent communication skills (English language).

CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.

Ce rôle appuie également la croissance de l'organisme de R-D en formant les membres de l'équipe aux principales plateformes scientifiques et technologiques. Principales responsabilités - Dirige la conception, la mise en oeuvre et l'optimisation des capacités techniques avancées, guidant les équipes interfonctionnelles pour atteindre des objectifs de recherche complexes dans des délais précis - Supervise la planification, l'exécution et l'interprétation d'expériences scientifiques à haut impact, garantissant les plus hautes normes de rigueur et d'intégrité scientifiques - Mentors et développe le personnel scientifique, favorisant la croissance technique et le transfert de connaissances dans l'ensemble de l'organisation - Fonctionne comme une autorité reconnue sur le terrain, contribuant à la stratégie scientifique, à la planification du portefeuille et aux collaborations externes - Gérer des projets ou des programmes à grande échelle et interfonctionnels avec une surveillance minimale, en assurant l'alignement sur les objectifs organisationnels et les attentes réglementaires - Se pose des problèmes complexes et multidimensionnels qui nécessitent une analyse technique approfondie et une collaboration interdisciplinaire - Représente l'organisation dans des forums scientifiques, des publications et des partenariats externes, renforçant la visibilité et le leadership de la pensée
• Vos compétences et votre expérience - Doctorat dans une discipline scientifique - En général, 5 à 8 ans d'expérience connexe - Suivi des réalisations scientifiques dans la discipline pertinente des sciences de la vie - Maîtrise des méthodologies avancées - Surveillance des équipes et initiatives de recherche interfonctionnelles - Orientation des programmes scientifiques - Excellentes compétences en communication (langue anglaise). À propos de CSL Behring CSL Behring est un chef de file mondial en biothérapeutique animé par notre promesse de sauver des vies. Concentré sur les besoins des patients en utilisant les dernières technologies, nous découvrons, développons et livrons des thérapies innovantes pour les personnes vivant dans des conditions dans les domaines immunologiques, hématologiques, cardiovasculaires et métaboliques, respiratoires et transplantés. Nous utilisons trois plateformes scientifiques stratégiques de fractionnement plasmatique, la technologie des protéines recombinantes et la thérapie cellulaire et génique pour soutenir l'innovation continue et affiner continuellement les façons dont les produits peuvent répondre aux besoins médicaux non satisfaits et aider les patients à mener une vie entière. CSL Behring exploite l'un des plus grands réseaux mondiaux de collecte de plasma, CSL Plasma. Notre société mère, CSL, basée à Melbourne, en Australie, emploie 32 000 personnes et livre ses thérapies vitales à des personnes dans plus de 100 pays. Nos avantages Pour plus d'information sur les avantages de la LSC, visitez Comment la LSC soutient votre bien-être. Vous appartenez à CSL Chez CSL, l'inclusion et l'appartenance sont au cœur de notre mission et de ce que nous sommes. Elle alimente notre journée de l'innovation au quotidien. En célébrant nos différences et en créant une culture de curiosité et d'empathie, nous sommes en mesure de mieux comprendre et de communiquer avec nos patients et nos donateurs, de favoriser de solides relations avec nos intervenants et de maintenir une main-d'oeuvre diversifiée qui fera de notre entreprise et de notre industrie le moteur de la croissance économique

jobs.description:
For our global Technical Operations Organization, we are currently looking for a

Analytical Testing Lead / Principal Scientist (m/f/x )

Fullltime / Permanent / Closing date April 17th
Locations available: Bern

The Opportunity
This role drives the discovery and development of innovative medicines that address unmet medical needs, guiding projects from early research through clinical trials and toward global commercialization. It ensures the highest standards of clinical safety while managing advanced research analyses, information systems, and technical documentation. The position also supports laboratory activities and helps maintain regulatory approvals by collaborating closely with health authorities. Additionally, it provides expert scientific guidance, implements specialized technical capabilities, and contributes to rigorous experiment planning, execution, and reporting. The role further supports the growth of the R&D organization by training team members in key scientific and technological platforms.

Key Responsibilities:

• Leads the design, implementation, and optimization of advanced technical capabilities, guiding cross-functional teams to achieve complex research objectives within defined timelines

• Oversees the planning, execution, and interpretation of high-impact scientific experiments, ensuring the highest standards of scientific rigor and integrity

• Mentors and develops scientific staff, fostering technical growth and knowledge transfer across the organization

• Serves as a recognized authority in the field, contributing to scientific strategy, portfolio planning, and external collaborations

• Manages large-scale, cross-functional projects or programs with minimal oversight, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and regulatory expectations

• Solves complex, multi-dimensional problems requiring deep technical insight and cross-disciplinary collaboration

• Represents the organization in scientific forums, publications, and external partnerships, enhancing visibility and thought leadership

Your skills and experience

• PhD in a scientific discipline

• Typically, 5–8 years of related experience

• Track record of scientific achievement in relevant Life Sciences discipline

• Mastery of advanced methodologies

• Oversight of research cross-functional teams and initiatives

• Setting direction for scientific programs

• Excellent communication skills (English language).

CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.

CSL Behring gestisce una delle più grandi reti di raccolta al plasma del mondo, CSL Plasma. jobs.description:
For our global Technical Operations Organization, we are currently looking for a

Analytical Testing Lead / Principal Scientist (m/f/x)

Fullltime / Permanent / Closing date April 17th
Locations available: Bern

The Opportunity
This role drives the discovery and development of innovative medicines that address unmet medical needs, guiding projects from early research through clinical trials and toward global commercialization. It ensures the highest standards of clinical safety while managing advanced research analyses, information systems, and technical documentation. The position also supports laboratory activities and helps maintain regulatory approvals by collaborating closely with health authorities. Additionally, it provides expert scientific guidance, implements specialized technical capabilities, and contributes to rigorous experiment planning, execution, and reporting. The role further supports the growth of the R&D organization by training team members in key scientific and technological platforms.

Key Responsibilities:

• Leads the design, implementation, and optimization of advanced technical capabilities, guiding cross-functional teams to achieve complex research objectives within defined timelines

• Oversees the planning, execution, and interpretation of high-impact scientific experiments, ensuring the highest standards of scientific rigor and integrity

• Mentors and develops scientific staff, fostering technical growth and knowledge transfer across the organization

• Serves as a recognized authority in the field, contributing to scientific strategy, portfolio planning, and external collaborations

• Manages large-scale, cross-functional projects or programs with minimal oversight, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and regulatory expectations

• Solves complex, multi-dimensional problems requiring deep technical insight and cross-disciplinary collaboration

• Represents the organization in scientific forums, publications, and external partnerships, enhancing visibility and thought leadership

Your skills and experience

• PhD in a scientific discipline

• Typically, 5–8 years of related experience

• Track record of scientific achievement in relevant Life Sciences discipline

• Mastery of advanced methodologies

• Oversight of research cross-functional teams and initiatives

• Setting direction for scientific programs

• Excellent communication skills (English language).

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

Our Benefits
For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL .

You Belong at CSL
At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakeholders, and sustain a diverse workforce that will move our company and industry into the f

jobs.description:
Principal Scientist, Tech Ops (Tech Transfer and Outsourcing)

R-275563
Fullltime / Permanent / CF Level 7
Locations available: Bern

Position Description Summary​

• Lead and oversee technology transfer activities for processes and/or QC analytical methods, including transfer between development, manufacturing, and external partner laboratories.

• Define and execute transfer strategies, protocols, acceptance criteria, and readiness assessments to ensure successful implementation at receiving sites.

• Serve as the primary technical point of contact for external partners, including CDMOs and contract laboratories, ensuring alignment on technical expectations, timelines, and quality standards.

• Provide scientific oversight of outsourced activities, including issue resolution, deviation investigations and performance monitoring.

• Support preparation, review, and defense of CMC‑related regulatory documentation associated with tech transfer, outsourcing, and lifecycle changes.

• Provide scientific input to regulatory interactions, including responses to health authority questions related to transferred technologies.

• Support post‑approval lifecycle activities, including site additions, method updates, and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Collaborate effectively with cross‑functional stakeholders (e.g., Development, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, etc).

• Researches and develops new medicines for unmet medical needs through innovative medical science from inception, through clinical trials to commercialization.

• Assesses, monitors and ensures products meet clinical safety standards.

• Conducts sophisticated analysis, manages research information systems and technical documentation.

• May be involved in providing para-professional laboratory support for product testing after collection.

• Provide high level scientific expertise and guidance in specialist technical areas of research and product development related activities. ​

• Implements technical capabilities with and provides relevant technical guidance to other team members in order to achieve specified research project objectives within defined time parameters. ​

• Contributes to the planning, performance, evaluation and reporting of scientific experiments at the highest levels of scientific integrity ​

• Contributes to training of staff in relevant research and development technology platform​

Main Responsibilities & Accountabilities​

• Providing leadership for projects and workstreams in a matrix organization

• Recognized subject matter expert in job area typically obtained through advanced education and work experience​

• Manages large projects or processes with limited oversight from manager​

• Coaches, trains, reviews, and delegates work to lower level professionals​

• Problems faced are difficult and often complex, requiring analysis of issues and consideration of other job areas​

Qualifications & Experience

• Postgraduate degree (preferably MSc or PhD) and / or extensive experience in relevant discipline. ​

• Minimum of 5 years' relevant industry experience and / or equivalent experience in a relevant academic environment.​

• Track record of scientific achievement in relevant Life Sciences discipline.​

• Experience working in cross-functional, multicultural and international teams.​

• Excellent communication skills (English language).​

Different qualifica

Fornire competenze scientifiche di alto livello e guida in settori tecnici specializzati di attività di ricerca e sviluppo di prodotti correlati. - Implementa le capacità tecniche e fornisce una guida tecnica rilevante agli altri membri del team al fine di raggiungere obiettivi specifici del progetto di ricerca entro parametri di tempo definiti. - Contribuisce alla pianificazione, alle prestazioni, alla valutazione e alla segnalazione di esperimenti scientifici ai massimi livelli di integrità scientifica - Contribuisce alla formazione del personale nella piattaforma di ricerca e sviluppo Responsabilità principale & Accountabilità - Tracciare il record di successo scientifico nella disciplina relativa delle scienze della vita. - Esperienza di lavoro in team interfunzionali, multiculturali e internazionali. - Eccellente capacità di comunicazione (lingua inglese).
